title: Software Engineer - Go Specialist
description:
Software Engineer – Go/Golang Backend | Cybersecurity Platform

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Software Engineer specializing in backend development to help build and scale the infrastructure powering a modern cybersecurity platform.

This is not a basic CRUD development role. You’ll work on technically challenging systems involving:

  • Go/Golang backend services
  • High-volume security data processing
  • Distributed and event-driven systems
  • 100+ third-party integrations
  • Scalable APIs and data pipelines
  • Cloud infrastructure
  • Multi-tenant data architecture

If you enjoy solving complex backend, infrastructure, and integration problems at scale, this role offers strong technical ownership and impact.

What You’ll Own

Backend Engineering – Go & APIs

  • Build and maintain backend services primarily using Go (Golang).
  • Design scalable REST APIs and internal microservices.
  • Implement authentication, rate limiting, retry mechanisms, fault tolerance, and robust error handling.
  • Write maintainable, production-ready code designed for reliability and scale.
  • Diagnose performance bottlenecks and improve backend efficiency.

Enterprise Integrations

  • Build and maintain integrations across 100+ enterprise systems.
  • Work extensively with REST APIs, OAuth, webhooks, and external services.
  • Design integrations that remain reliable as data volume and customer usage scale.
  • Troubleshoot integration failures and improve resilience.
  • Implement monitoring and observability around integration health.

Event-Driven Systems & Data Pipelines

  • Design event-driven architectures for processing security data.
  • Build pipelines for data ingestion, transformation, and enrichment.
  • Work with asynchronous processing, messaging systems, and distributed workflows.
  • Ensure high-volume data can be processed reliably and efficiently.

PostgreSQL & Data Architecture

  • Design scalable data models for multi-tenant applications.
  • Work extensively with PostgreSQL.
  • Design schemas and optimize complex queries.
  • Improve indexing and database performance.
  • Support both operational and analytics-oriented data requirements.
  • Maintain data integrity as the platform scales.

Cloud Infrastructure & Observability

  • Deploy and operate services across cloud environments, with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) preferred.
  • Work with scalable compute, managed storage, and messaging infrastructure.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and observability.
  • Diagnose production issues and improve system reliability.
  • Contribute to infrastructure and platform scalability initiatives.

Architecture & Platform Development

  • Collaborate with Product, Security, and Engineering teams.
  • Participate in architecture decisions and technical design reviews.
  • Identify opportunities to improve platform reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Contribute to AI-powered security workflows and automation initiatives.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Strong professional backend software engineering experience.
  • Proficiency in Go/Golang, or strong experience with Python, Java, or TypeScript with willingness to transition to Go.
  • Experience building production APIs and distributed backend systems.
  • Strong relational database experience, ideally PostgreSQL.
  • Experience with at least one major cloud platform:
    • GCP
    • AWS
    • Azure
  • Hands-on understanding of:
    • REST APIs
    • Webhooks
    • Authentication systems
    • Asynchronous processing
    • Database design and optimization
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to independently own technical problems through resolution.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Nice to Have

Experience with any of the following is highly valuable:

  • OAuth
  • Event-driven architectures
  • Message queues and asynchronous systems
  • Distributed systems
  • High-volume data pipelines
  • Multi-tenant SaaS architecture
  • Cybersecurity platforms
  • SIEM systems
  • Identity and access management
  • Endpoint security platforms
  • Startup or high-growth engineering environments
  • AI/LLM-powered applications and workflows

Core Technology Stack

Backend: Go / Golang
Database: PostgreSQL
APIs: REST, OAuth, Webhooks
Cloud: GCP preferred; AWS/Azure relevant
Architecture: Microservices, distributed systems, event-driven processing
Infrastructure: Messaging systems, monitoring, logging, observability

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’re likely to succeed if you:

  • Prefer backend and systems engineering over frontend/UI development.
  • Have built production systems designed for scale.
  • Understand that integrations need to handle failures, retries, rate limits, and changing external APIs.
  • Care about clean architecture and long-term maintainability.
  • Think deeply about reliability, performance, and observability.
  • Can troubleshoot complex production issues systematically.
  • Take ownership without requiring constant direction.
  • Enjoy fast-moving, engineering-heavy environments.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may spend your day:

  • Building and shipping backend services in Go.
  • Designing an integration with an external enterprise platform.
  • Debugging a production integration or data-processing issue.
  • Optimizing PostgreSQL queries and indexes.
  • Improving API reliability and performance.
  • Building or refining event-driven data pipelines.
  • Reviewing architecture decisions with other engineers.
  • Improving monitoring and observability.
  • Supporting AI-powered security and automation workflows.

In short: you’ll build the scalable backend infrastructure, integrations, and data systems that power a modern cybersecurity platform.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Backend reliability and uptime.
  • API latency and performance.
  • Scalability under increasing workloads.
  • Reliable processing of high-volume security data.
  • Reduced third-party integration failures.
  • Database and query performance.
  • Platform stability and maintainability.
  • Quality and speed of engineering execution.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Work on real distributed backend systems, not basic application development.
  • Solve challenging integration problems across 100+ enterprise systems.
  • Build infrastructure supporting high-volume cybersecurity data.
  • Work across APIs, databases, event-driven architecture, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Exposure to AI-powered security workflows.
  • Strong technical ownership in a fully remote environment.
  • Growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Backend Engineer
    • Senior Go Engineer
    • Platform Engineer
    • Systems Architect
    • Infrastructure Lead

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Technical Interview
  3. Practical Backend/API Assessment
  4. Cross-Functional Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you’re a backend engineer who enjoys Go/Golang, distributed systems, PostgreSQL, APIs, integrations, and scalable infrastructure, we’d love to hear from you.

Join a technically challenging environment where you can build backend systems that process security data at scale and directly influence the architecture and reliability of a growing cybersecurity platform.

title: Software Engineer
description:
About the Role

Join a small, fast-moving engineering team at a seed-stage AI voice platform company building the infrastructure that powers thousands of automated customer conversations every day. This is a high-impact, end-to-end ownership role — you'll work directly alongside customers, shape core architecture decisions, and ship meaningful product experiences in an AI-first, communications-enabled environment. You'll be part of a driven, low-ego team working on-site in Berlin.

What You'll Do

  • Work closely with customers to deeply understand their problems and design product experiences that solve real challenges.

  • Build scalable backend infrastructure capable of handling thousands of AI-driven phone calls per day.

  • Create intuitive, AI-first user experiences that set a new standard for human–machine interaction.

  • Own high-stakes projects end-to-end — from initial concept through production deployment and post-release support.

  • Contribute to core architectural decisions that shape the platform's future.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering experience.

  • Strong PostgreSQL experience, including complex queries, performance tuning, and optimization.

  • Proven experience designing scalable backend architectures and making core product and architectural decisions.

  • Experience with scalable async processing or real-time processing systems.

  • Hands-on experience building products for AI-first or communications-enabled platforms.

  • Demonstrated ability to take a product from 0 to 1 and own it through production.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills — able to translate customer problems into product solutions.

  • Familiarity with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and Python.

  • Willingness to work on-site in Berlin, Germany.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Temporal.io, Twilio, or Modal.

  • Experience with voice infrastructure or telephony systems.

  • Background at a startup or high-growth technology company.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: €75,000 – €160,000 per year, depending on experience.

  • Visa sponsorship is available.

Location

This role is on-site in Berlin, Germany. Candidates must be willing and able to work from the Berlin office. Remote work is not available for this position.

title: Työnjohtaja, sähköasemien kunnossapito
description:
Haluatko johtaa sähköasemien kunnossapitotöitä osana kasvavaa energia-alan huippuorganisaatiota?

Haemme työnjohtajaa Vantaan Tammiston toimipisteeseen vastaamaan sähköasemien huolto- ja kunnossapitotöiden toteutuksesta pääkaupunkiseudulla.

Tehtävässä suunnittelet ja resursoit töitä, johdat niiden toteutusta, raportoit sekä vastaat taloudellisista tavoitteista yhdessä osaavan tiimin kanssa. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä asiakkaiden, oman henkilöstön ja alihankkijoiden kanssa. Työ sisältää sekä toimistotyötä Vantaalla että käyntejä työkohteissa pääkaupunkiseudulla.

Perehdytämme sinut työtehtäviin mittavalla perehdytysjaksolla. Perehdytämme myös kokeneen sähköalan ammattilaisen, jolla ei vielä ole kokemusta sähköasemakunnossapidosta.

Olet etsimämme henkilö, jos sinulla on:

• Sähköalan koulutus (esim. sähköinsinööri)

• Kokemusta sähköasemista, sähkönjakelusta tai sähköverkkoympäristöstä

• Hyvät organisointi- ja yhteistyötaidot

• Asiakaslähtöinen ja aktiivinen työote

• Hyvä suomen kielen ja kohtuullinen englannin kielen taito

• Hyvä tietotekninen osaaminen eri järjestelmien kanssa

• Vähintään B-ajokortti, oman auton käyttö katsotaan eduksi

• Valmius esihenkilötyöhön sovitulla aikajänteellä

• Hyvä asenne työturvallisuuteen. Työt sähköasemilla vaativat kykyä sopeutua työturvallisuuden kannalta välttämättömiin ohjeisiin ja määräyksiin. Työturvallisuus on ajatuksemme ydin kaikissa töissämme!

Mitä tarjoamme?

• Merkityksellisen työn energia-alan murroksen ytimessä

• Mahdollisuuden kehittyä esihenkilö- ja asiantuntijatehtävissä

• Ammattitaitoisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön tuen

• Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan.

• Lisäksi arkeasi tukevat kattava työterveyshuolto, virike-etu, osakesäästöohjelma sekä mahdollisuus osallistua hyväntekeväisyyteen konsernimme säätiön kautta.

Toimintaamme ohjaa viisi arvoa: luottamus, autonomia, vastuullisuus, yrittäjähenkisyys ja solidaarisuus. Ne näkyvät arjessamme – tavassamme tehdä töitä, kohdata toisemme ja kehittää yhteistä tulevaisuutta. Meillä arvostetaan hyvää tiimihenkeä, työn monipuolisuutta, yhdessä onnistumista sekä mahdollisuutta oppia uutta ja kehittyä. Jaamme osaamista, tuemme toisiamme ja rakennamme yhdessä kestävää tulevaisuutta.

Tuntuuko tehtävä sinulle sopivalta? Kiinnostuitko mahdollisuudesta työskennellä meillä?

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten kannattaa toimia nopeasti!
Täytä hakemus ja kerro tarkemmin itsestäsi ja osaamisestasi 24.8.2026 mennessä.


Lisätietoa tehtävästä antaa

Jani Gratschev, jani.gratschev@omexom.com , puh. 050 453 4421

Tietoa työnantajasta

Energia-alan jatkuvien muutosten keskellä Omexom auttaa asiakkaitaan saavuttamaan energiasiirtymän tavoitteet. Hyödyntäen laaja-alaista osaamistaan sähkö- ja kaasualalla, Omexom rakentaa vähähiilisiä energialähteitä, kehittää sähköverkkoa, edistää energian tehokasta käyttöä sekä toteuttaa innovatiivisia ja yhteistyöhön perustuvia ratkaisuja.

Projektimme ja palvelumme ovat suunnattuja energiantuottajille, siirto- ja jakeluverkkoyhtiöille, paikallis- ja alueviranomaisille sekä niiden käyttäjille kaikilla alueilla. Omexom etsii jatkuvasti parhaita teknologisia vaihtoehtoja ja toteuttaa asiakkailleen soveltuvimmat ratkaisut täysin riippumattomana toimittajista.

Omexom on VINCI Energiesin energia-alan ratkaisuihin erikoistunut brändi. Ympäri Suomen meitä on noin 500 henkilöä.

title: University Partnership and Program Manager
description:
University Partnership and Program ManagerThis role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:

We are looking for a highly organized and relationship-driven University Partnership and Program Manager to lead HPE's university programs and strategic partnerships across the Americas. In this role, you'll oversee campus events, volunteer engagement, university partnerships, graduate onboarding, and the Campus Teams Program while partnering with business leaders, HR, and the University Center of Excellence to strengthen HPE's early career talent pipeline.

Responsibilities:

  • Support HPE’s US end-to-end recruitment throughout the entire recruitment lifecycle, from requisition creation to onboarding.

  • Develop and maintain relationships with strategic universities and organizations to enhance HPE’s talent pipeline and support early identification programs.

  • Coordinate and supervise university talent pipeline from sourcing to offer to ensure a diverse and high-quality candidate pool.

  • Plan, coordinate, and execute recruitment events to showcase HPE’s employer brand.

  • Manage HPE volunteers and attendees during events, ensuring a positive experience for both.

  • Manage the AMS HPE Campus Teams Program and Graduate Onboarding, including identifying and training HPE team members, program coordination, and budget management.

  • Provide support and framework to HPE’s Global Campus Teams Program and Onboarding operating outside of AMS to ensure a cohesive global approach.

  • Work closely with HPE’s University Center of Excellence, business stakeholders, and HR partners on critical projects to deploy strategies for meeting recruitment goals with significant staffing impact.

  • Collaborate with cross-function teams to address hiring challenges and implement solutions.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience preferred.

  • 4+ years of related experience in program management, event management, university programs, talent programs, or a related field.

  • Experience planning, coordinating, and executing large-scale programs, events, or initiatives.

  • Experience in university recruitment is a plus

  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and relationship management skills for internal and external stakeholders

  • Strong organizational, project management, and data management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • Willingness to travel to support university recruiting events and strategic campus initiatives during peak recruiting seasons.

What We Can Offer You:

Health & Wellbeing

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

Technical Project Lead - Modelling and Simulation Engineer

Defence & Aerospace

Competitive Salary, Plus Benefits & Hybrid Working

Security Clearance Essential

Step into a role that blends real-world impact with hands-on technical leadership. As a Technical Project Lead - Modelling and Simulation Engineer, you'll guide delivery across marine-focused projects in a fast-moving, collaborative environment. If making complex work feel structured and achievable is your thing, this Technical Project Lead - Modelling and Simulation Engineer position is built for you.

As a Technical Project Lead - Modelling and Simulation Engineer you will:

This Technical Project Lead - Modelling and Simulation Engineer role supports the company's commitment to operational excellence and future-proof engineering by applying proven expertise in engineering, technology, and consulting. The focus on quality, collaborative delivery, and model-based design helps drive dependable outcomes for both commercial and defence environments, reinforcing a culture of integrity and transparency.

description:
We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer / Subject Matter Expert (SME) to join a high-performing Agile development team supporting the design, development, and enhancement of mission-critical software solutions. The successful candidate will have extensive experience developing modern web applications, designing scalable search and retrieval systems, and integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Large Language Model (LLM) technologies into enterprise environments.

This role requires expertise in full-stack software development, cloud technologies, Elasticsearch, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and modern DevOps practices within a Lean Agile environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Collaborate with product owners, engineers, architects, security teams, operations personnel, and testers throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Design, develop, enhance, and maintain scalable enterprise software applications.
  • Translate business, customer, and system requirements into technical designs and software solutions.
  • Develop modern Single Page Applications (SPA) using React, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.
  • Design and develop RESTful APIs using Node.Js, Express, or comparable backend technologies.
  • Build scalable enterprise search and retrieval capabilities utilizing Elasticsearch.
  • Design, develop, and integrate AI-powered solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
  • Develop data ingestion, indexing, embedding, and vector search pipelines supporting AI-enabled applications.
  • Implement software testing, debugging, code reviews, and quality assurance activities.
  • Manage software versioning, vendor software updates, and patch management.
  • Support cloud-based deployments and application integration within AWS and/or Microsoft Azure environments.
  • Utilize DevOps tools and CI/CD pipelines to automate software delivery and deployment.
  • Provide technical support, troubleshooting, and engineering expertise throughout the software lifecycle.
Required Qualifications

Candidates should possess demonstrated experience in the following areas:

Software Development
  • Full software development lifecycle (SDLC) within a Lean Agile environment.
  • Designing technical solutions based on customer and system requirements.
  • Developing enterprise software applications and system interfaces.
  • Front-end development using:
    • React (modern Hooks architecture)
    • HTML5
    • CSS3
    • JavaScript
  • Back-end development using:
    • Node.Js
    • Express
    • RESTful API development
AI & Search Technologies
  • Designing and implementing Large Language Model (LLM) solutions.
  • Building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications.
  • Developing semantic search and AI-assisted retrieval systems.
  • Designing enterprise search architectures using Elasticsearch.
  • Creating data ingestion, document chunking, embedding generation, vector search, and retrieval pipelines.
  • Experience with search relevance tuning, index optimization, and scalable search architectures.
Cloud & DevOps
  • AWS and/or Microsoft Azure cloud environments.
  • Git source control.
  • Jenkins CI/CD.
  • Nexus or similar artifact repositories.
  • Software version control and release management.
Web Technologies
  • Internet and web technologies including:
    • Node.Js
    • Apache Tomcat
    • Web Services
    • SSL/TLS
Testing
  • Unit testing
  • Automated testing frameworks such as:
    • Jest
    • Karma
Preferred Qualifications

Preference will be given to candidates with experience in:

  • Sponsor-specific Lean Agile development methodologies.
  • Evaluating, selecting, and integrating commercial or open-source Large Language Models into enterprise environments.
  • OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar LLM platforms.
  • Hybrid search architectures combining keyword and semantic search.
  • Vector databases and embedding technologies.
  • AI relevance optimization and prompt engineering.
  • Enterprise search architecture.
  • Technical leadership, solution architecture, and mentoring software engineering teams.
  • Establishing best practices for AI, enterprise search, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will demonstrate:

  • Extensive experience designing and deploying production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions.
  • Advanced expertise with Elasticsearch, including:
    • Index architecture
    • Schema design
    • Query optimization
    • Relevance tuning

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Us

Loop IQ is a purpose-built intelligence platform helping care organisations move beyond fragmented spreadsheets and manual reporting — delivering the accuracy, auditability, and confidence that regulated environments demand. Alongside the platform sits our strategic consulting wing, guiding organisations through implementation and optimisation so the technology delivers from day one.


Why Work with Loop IQ?
  • Build something that matters — We’re solving a real problem in a sector that affects millions of Australians. The work you do here has a direct line to better outcomes in aged care.
  • Grow with intention — Dedicated learning budgets, performance bonuses, and genuine wellbeing support.
  • A culture worth showing up for — A small, high-trust team that values different perspectives, moves fast, and communicates openly. No politics, just good people doing meaningful work.
  • Rare access, real impact — We operate at the intersection of health data, government, and enterprise, with relationships that are hard to find at this stage of a company.

About the Role

You’ll own the data platform end to end — architecture, standards, and roadmap — while leading a small team of data engineers (currently two, growing).

Expect roughly 70% build, 30% lead. You’ll still be in the code every week; you’ll also be the person the team looks to for direction, review, and unblocking.

Leading

  • Own the architecture from ingestion through to the models that power the product, and make the trade-off calls on cost, complexity, and time to value
  • Set engineering standards across the data team — code review, testing, documentation, definition of done
  • Run day-to-day delivery and prioritisation alongside the product and software engineering leads
  • Mentor engineers through pairing and review, and help shape how the team hires as it grows

Building

  • Design and maintain reusable in-house PySpark frameworks that standardise data engineering patterns across the platform
  • Architect production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines across AWS, with distributed processing in Python and PySpark on Databricks
  • Build batch and near real-time ingestion integrating third-party clinical systems, healthcare APIs, and enterprise platforms
  • Design secure integration patterns (REST APIs, SFTP, event-driven ingestion, webhooks) that hold up to compliance and data integrity requirements
  • Work with the software team so the application backend and data layer integrate cleanly
  • Implement CI/CD with Git, plus infrastructure-as-code and environment management across AWS
  • Optimise Spark jobs, cluster configuration, and storage for performance and cost
  • Design robust data models, including dimensional and SaaS-oriented schemas
  • Build validation, monitoring, and alerting so pipeline failures are caught by us, not our customers

About You
  • 6+ years in data engineering, including production systems in a SaaS or product-led environment
  • Experience leading a small team or holding technical ownership of a platform — formal management experience welcome but not essential
  • Advanced Python, SQL, and PySpark for large-scale distributed processing
  • Strong hands-on AWS (S3, Lambda, RDS, Glue, IAM) and deep Databricks cluster experience
  • Solid grasp of lakehouse and cloud-native data architecture, and the judgement to know when the simpler option is the right one
  • Experience integrating third-party systems via APIs and secure data exchange
  • Strong data modelling and governance knowledge
  • Automated testing for data pipelines, and solid DevOps fundamentals (Git workflows, branching, CI/CD)
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and limited process — you’ll be building some of it
  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field

Nice to have: healthcare, aged care, or other regulated data environments; standing up a data platform from an early stage; familiarity with Australian privacy and health data obligations.

title: Ledsagare sökes i Skäggetorp
description:
På Olivia arbetar vi tillsammans för alla människors rätt till att leva livet fullt ut. Nu söker vi ytterligare en kollega till vårt team, är det du?

Om tjänsten

Söker du ett jobb där du gör verklig skillnad i någons vardag? Vi söker nu en trygg, positiv och tålmodig person som vill hänga med en ungdom på olika vardagsaktiviteter. Det viktigaste för oss är inte vad du har på ditt CV, utan vem du är som person. Arbetstiderna är flexibla men både dagtid samt helg kan förekomma.

Ungdomen har Rapid Onset Dystonia Parkinsonism (RDP). Det är en sällsynt neurologisk diagnos som innebär att de motoriska signalerna i kroppen är påverkade. Symtomen visar sig framför allt genom stelhet, skakningar och muskelsammandragningar (dystoni). För denna ungdom innebär det i vardagen att rörelseförmågan är nedsatt och om man går på promenad är det framförallt balansen som påverkas och går gärna i handkrok under promenaden.

Ditt uppdrag handlar om att förgylla vardagen och ge stöd under lättare aktiviteter. Det kan till exempel handla om att:

  • Ta sköna promenader i lugnt tempo.

  • Gå ner på stan för en fika.

  • Göra andra lättare och roliga utflykter tillsammans.


Om dig

Vi söker dig som trivs med att arbeta med människor och har förmåga att förstå och möta individers olika behov. Du är lyhörd, initiativrik, lösningsorienterad och engagerad. Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.

Meriter:

Vi har inga strikta krav på utbildning gällande den här insatsen, men vi söker dig som uppfyller följande:

  • Tålmodig och lyhörd: Eftersom diagnosen gör att det inte går att gå så fort, är det viktigt att du trivs med ett lugnt och prestigelöst tempo.

  • Trygg och positiv: Du har en stabil personlighet och är enkel att umgås med.

  • Vårderfarenhet (meriterande): Det är ett plus om du har tidigare erfarenhet inom vård, omsorg eller som personlig assistent.

  • Språk (meriterande): Det är starkt meriterande om du talar ryska eller persiska (farsi).

Sysselsättningsgrad: 5% av heltid - 8 timmar i månaden.

Tillträde: Urvalet sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdagen. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan.

Att tänka på inför din ansökan:

En förutsättning för att påbörja en anställning hos på Olivia är att du som söker kan uppvisa giltig ID -handling och lämna in personbevis samt eventuella dokument som styrker rätten till arbete inom Sverige. Personbevis kan du enkelt ladda ned på Skatteverkets hemsida.

På grund av att tjänsten kan omfatta ensamarbete, nattarbete och arbetsuppgifter som enligt Arbetsmiljöverkets föreskrifter (AFS 2012:3) inte får utföras av minderåriga, måste du ha fyllt 18 år.

Om du vill arbeta med barn och unga under 18 år behöver du uppvisa utdrag ur belastningsregistret. Det är viktigt att utdragen beställs i god tid, eftersom Polisens handläggningstid kan variera.
Med anledning av lagändring från den 1 mars 2026 utökas registerkontrollen till att omfatta både utdrag ur belastningsregistret och utdrag från misstankeregistret.

Du beställer enkelt utdragen med BankID via denna länk:


Vi rekommenderar att du säkerställer att du har aktuella utdrag enligt de nya reglerna.

Om rekryteringsprocessen:Om du ger ditt samtycke kan vi dela din profil med våra systerbolag om din profil matchar en annan tjänst inom Team Olivia.

För dig med Anställningsstöd:

Olivia är ett inkluderande företag. Vi välkomnar alla sökanden och även du som har rätt till någon form av anställningsstöd genom arbetsförmedlingen . Det är frivilligt att ange denna information i din ansökan, alternativt kan du även meddela detta vid en eventuell intervju.

Om kollektivavtal och förmåner hos Olivia:

Som medarbetare omfattas du av kollektivavtal och självklart är du försäkrad på och till/från arbetet om något oförutsett skulle inträffa.

title: Project Manager - Clinical Projects - San Diego
description:
Project Manager – Clinical Projects

Location: San Diego, CA | Employment Type: Full-Time

Lead meaningful clinical projects that support life-changing therapies

PolyPeptide is seeking a Project Manager, Clinical Projects to lead customer-owned clinical projects from kickoff through successful delivery. This is a high-impact, customer-facing role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, regulated environment and enjoys bringing people, priorities, and timelines together.

In this role, you will be at the center of clinical project execution, partnering with customers, internal technical teams, Supply Chain, Commercial Operations, Quality, and Site Leadership to keep projects moving forward. You will help turn customer agreements into clear action plans, guide cross-functional teams through complex deliverables, and play a direct role in supporting programs tied to important pharmaceutical and biotech development.

Why this role matters

Clinical projects require strong coordination, clear communication, and disciplined execution. As the Project Manager, you will help ensure each project is delivered with the right balance of scope, cost, quality, timeline, regulatory expectations, and customer satisfaction.

This is an opportunity to make a visible impact across the organization while building trusted relationships with both internal partners and external customers.

What you will do

  • Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of customer clinical projects from initiation through completion

  • Build and manage project plans, timelines, milestones, risks, and deliverables

  • Serve as the central point of contact for customers and internal project teams

  • Lead cross-functional and multidisciplinary teams to keep work aligned, accountable, and moving forward

  • Monitor project scope and identify risks, bottlenecks, and out-of-scope activities

  • Drive milestone adherence and support on-time delivery

  • Coordinate with Supply Chain on deliveries and Commercial Operations on invoicing

  • Organize and lead internal and external project meetings

  • Prepare agendas, meeting minutes, project updates, status reports, and presentations

  • Communicate project progress clearly and consistently to customers and stakeholders

  • Escalate blocking issues and support timely decision-making

  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, communication, and project execution

  • Share lessons learned and contribute to local and global continuous improvement initiatives

What you bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, engineering, business, or related discipline

  • 3 to 5 years of project management experience

  • Experience leading cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders

  • Strong communication, organization, and relationship-building skills

  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a complex, regulated environment

  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving and decision-making skills

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and project management tools

Preferred experience

  • Experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, CDMO, or other regulated manufacturing environments

  • PMP or other project management certification

  • Advanced degree in a related discipline

  • Experience working directly with customers or external partners

What makes you a strong fit

You are someone who can bring structure to complexity. You know how to keep teams aligned, ask the right questions, identify risks early, and communicate clearly when priorities shift. You are comfortable working with customers and internal teams, and you enjoy being the person who helps move important work across the finish line.

Why join PolyPeptide

At PolyPeptide, you will be part of a quality-driven organization supporting clinical and pharmaceutical programs with real-world impact. You will work with experienced teams, contribute to meaningful customer projects, and help improve how we deliver across the business.

If you are looking for a role where your project leadership, communication skills, and problem-solving ability can make a measurable impact, we encourage you to apply.

title: Program Coordinator
description:
Who We Are

At ERC Pathlight, we’re on a mission to change lives—and we’re looking for people who feel called to do the same.

As one of the nation’s leading treatment providers for eating disorders and mood, anxiety, and trauma-related conditions, we bring innovative, evidence-based, and deeply compassionate care to patients across the country. With multiple locations nationwide and extensive virtual programming, we meet patients exactly where they are and help them move toward lasting recovery.

Founded in 2008 by renowned psychiatrists and psychologists, ERC Pathlight now supports more than 6,000 patients each year. And as the need for world-class mental health care continues to rise, our commitment is stronger than ever: to expand access, elevate the standard of care, and empower every patient to rebuild their life with dignity and hope.

Why Join Us

When you join ERC Pathlight, you become part of a team that shows up every day to make a real difference. You’ll work alongside passionate clinicians, dedicated support staff, and mission-driven leaders who believe in collaboration, growth, and doing the right thing—always.

Here, your work matters. Your ideas matter. You matter.

If you’re energized by purpose, motivated by impact, and ready to help transform the future of mental health treatment, you belong here.

Come build hope. Come save lives. Come grow with us.

What you’ll be doing:

Schedule: PRN Nights, 6:30pm to 7am

The Program Coordinator (PC I, PC II, PC III) is responsible for providing direct care and supervision to patients within inpatient, residential, and partial hospitalization levels of care at ERC Pathlight. Program Coordinators maintain a safe, structured, and therapeutic milieu while supporting the implementation of individualized treatment plans.

PCs provide patient supervision, maintain structure and boundaries, support therapeutic programming, assist with mealtime support, and complete required documentation. Level placement (I, II, III) is determined based on education, experience, and demonstrated competency.

Essential duties and responsibilities:

  • Milieu Management
  • Maintain daily program structure by following the established schedule
  • Complete observation rounds and safety checks as ordered by physician
  • Support patients with de-escalation and implementation of coping skills per treatment plan
  • Conduct room and luggage searches
  • Supervise fresh air breaks and mindful movement exposures
  • Provide ongoing bathroom monitoring
  • Obtain and document patient vital signs, weights, and urine specific gravity (as applicable by location/program)
  • Group Facilitation
  • Participate in facilitation of therapeutic groups
  • Complete required EHR documentation related to group facilitation
  • Support group-based social activities and meal outings
  • Meal Support
  • Participate in all meals and snacks with patients
  • Provide meal support using coaching and skills aligned with the treatment team
  • Complete timely and accurate meal-related documentation
  • Support dietitians in preparation for Nutrition and Cooking Groups
  • Ensure adherence to individualized meal plans and allergy-safety protocols
  • Support restaurant outings as needed
  • Administrative & Operational Support
  • Complete required documentation in compliance with organizational and regulatory standards, including patient observations, meals, and shift-related events
  • Provide patient transportation for medical appointments (as applicable by location/program)
  • Support additional transportation needs including outings, grocery procurement, or other facility needs
  • Assist with food procurement as needed (may occur weekly)
  • Distribute mail and packages daily

Position Expectations (All Levels)

  • All Program Coordinators must:
  • Be willing and able to work at all ERC Pathlight local sites as assigned
  • Be compliant with certification and regulatory requirements for each practice location
  • Maintain a flexible schedule to meet organizational staffing needs
  • Be available to work weekends and holidays as required
  • Be available to work on-call shifts based on business needs and in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local labor laws

Must haves:

Program Coordinator I (PC I)

  • High School Diploma or GED (Required)
  • Entry-level role: no prior direct patient care experience required unless required by state regulation (Required)
  • Valid driver’s license with safe driving record: required only at locations operating company vehicles or requiring driving on behalf of the company (Required)
  • Washington teammates must hold a state credential (may be pending at time of hire) (Required)
  • ServSafe certification may be required depending on state and local licensing regulations (Required)
  • Mental Health/Psych Tech or CNA certification (Preferred)

Program Coordinator II (PC II)

  • High School Diploma or GED (Required)
  • Minimum of one (1) year of direct patient care experience (Required)
  • Valid driver’s license with safe driving record: required only at locations operating company vehicles or requiring driving on behalf of the company (Required)
  • Washington teammates must hold a state credential (may be pending at time of hire) (Required)
  • ServSafe certification may be required depending on state and local licensing regulations (Required)
  • Mental Health/Psych Tech or CAN certification (Preferred)

Program Coordinator III (PC III)

  • Bachelor’s degree in behavioral health or related field (Required)
  • Minimum of six (6) months of experience in a behavioral health or related field (Required)
  • Valid driver’s license with safe driving record: required only at locations operating company vehicles or requiring driving on behalf of the company (Required)
  • Washington teammates must hold a state credential (may be pending at time of hire) (Required)
  • ServSafe certification may be required depending on state and local licensing regulations (Required)
  • Mental Health/Psych Tech or CAN certification (Preferred)

#ERC

The compensation range for this position is based upon candidate experience and market expectations.

Illinois Pay Range
$18.25—$29 USD

What We Offer

At ERC Pathlight, caring for people is our mission and that begins with caring for our own team. Your well-being matters, and our benefit program is designed to support every part of your life.

We offer competitive compensation; comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage; generous Paid Time Off; Parental Leave benefits; Retirement benefits; and tuition reimbursement to help you continue growing in your career.

We also recognize that mental health is part of every person’s experience. That’s why we strive to create a workplace where you feel supported, seen, and encouraged—personally, professionally, and at home.

When you thrive, you can do your best work. And your best work changes lives.

title: Video Editor
description:
Video Editor (Adobe Premiere, Social Media & Marketing Content) – Remote | U.S. Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours, with flexibility for launches, campaigns, and deadlines

About the Role

At Pavago, we’re hiring a Video Editor for one of our clients to create engaging, polished, and performance-driven video content across social media, marketing campaigns, paid advertising, websites, and internal communications.

This is more than a technical editing role. You’ll be responsible for turning raw footage into compelling stories designed to capture attention, increase watch time, improve audience retention, and strengthen campaign performance.

You’ll create and optimize content across platforms including TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube, LinkedIn, websites, and paid advertising channels.

If you understand how editing pace, storytelling, hooks, visuals, and platform-specific formats influence content performance, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Video Editing & Content Creation

  • Edit raw footage into polished, engaging, and professional videos.
  • Create both short-form and long-form content.
  • Work with editing platforms such as:
    • Adobe Premiere Pro
    • Final Cut Pro
    • DaVinci Resolve
  • Build edits around strong storytelling, pacing, and audience attention.
  • Create compelling openings and maintain viewer interest throughout each video.
  • Align every edit with brand guidelines, campaign objectives, and marketing goals.
  • Adapt editing styles based on platform, audience, and content purpose.

Social Media & Platform Optimization

  • Create platform-native video content for:
    • TikTok
    • Instagram Reels
    • YouTube & YouTube Shorts
    • LinkedIn
    • Websites
    • Paid advertising campaigns
  • Adapt content into multiple aspect ratios, including:
    • 16:9
    • 9:16
    • 1:1
  • Repurpose footage into multiple pieces of content without making each version feel repetitive.
  • Optimize exports for the appropriate combination of quality, file size, and platform requirements.
  • Understand how editing styles differ between short-form social content, long-form video, and advertising creative.

Motion Graphics & Visual Enhancements

  • Add professional:
    • Captions
    • Titles
    • Lower thirds
    • Motion graphics
    • Transitions
    • Visual overlays
  • Use tools such as Adobe After Effects and Canva when appropriate.
  • Maintain consistent typography, visual language, and brand presentation.
  • Enhance videos without over-editing or distracting from the core message.

Audio & Color

  • Clean and balance audio for professional output.
  • Improve dialogue clarity and reduce unwanted background noise.
  • Handle audio syncing and volume leveling.
  • Add appropriate licensed music and sound effects.
  • Perform color correction and grading.
  • Maintain visual consistency between different cameras, clips, and environments.

Footage & Project Management

  • Import, organize, and maintain raw footage and creative assets.
  • Keep project files and folder structures clean and consistent.
  • Maintain clear version control throughout revision cycles.
  • Archive completed projects so footage and assets can be easily retrieved and repurposed.
  • Manage multiple editing projects and deadlines simultaneously.

Collaboration & Revisions

  • Work closely with:
    • Marketing teams
    • Content strategists
    • Creative teams
  • Receive and manage feedback through tools such as Frame.io and shared review systems.
  • Turn revisions around quickly while maintaining quality.
  • Communicate clearly about timelines, creative requirements, and deliverables.
  • Incorporate stakeholder feedback without losing consistency or creative direction.

Performance Optimization

  • Review content performance metrics including:
    • Watch time
    • Audience retention
    • Engagement
    • CTR
  • Identify patterns in high- and low-performing content.
  • Apply performance insights to future edits.
  • Collaborate with marketing teams to test new hooks, formats, pacing, and creative approaches.
  • Continuously improve editing decisions based on actual audience behavior.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You understand that great video editing is about storytelling and attention, not just transitions and effects.
  • You know how to make the opening seconds of a video count.
  • You can edit both short-form and long-form content effectively.
  • You understand how content consumption differs across TikTok, Reels, YouTube, LinkedIn, and paid ads.
  • You can execute quickly without sacrificing quality.
  • You’re highly organized and comfortable managing multiple projects.
  • You take ownership of your work from raw footage through final export.
  • You’re receptive to feedback and can handle revision cycles professionally.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of professional video editing experience.
  • Strong proficiency with one or more of:
    • Adobe Premiere Pro
    • Final Cut Pro
    • DaVinci Resolve
  • Experience editing social media and marketing content.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Video pacing
    • Storytelling
    • Viewer retention
    • Platform-specific content
  • Experience with:
    • Audio cleanup and syncing
    • Color correction
    • Captions and graphics
    • Multi-platform formatting
    • Platform-specific exports
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Portfolio demonstrating professional video editing work.

Preferred Experience

  • Adobe After Effects and motion graphics experience.
  • Experience editing:
    • Paid advertising creatives
    • UGC-style videos
    • Performance marketing content
    • Short-form social content
    • Long-form YouTube content
  • Familiarity with performance metrics such as:
    • Watch time
    • Audience retention
    • CTR
    • Engagement
  • Experience using Frame.io or similar creative review platforms.
  • Background supporting:
    • SaaS companies
    • E-commerce brands
    • Marketing agencies
    • Media companies

What a Typical Day Looks Like

A Video Editor’s day revolves around turning raw footage into content people actually want to watch. You will:

  • Review and organize incoming footage and creative briefs.
  • Edit short-form and long-form videos.
  • Create social media and marketing campaign content.

Our experienced professionals have been a part of the growth and modernization of emergency management for nearly 30 years, proudly supporting programs for some of the most challenging natural disasters and catastrophic events under our mission of staying competent, caring, and connected.

MISSION

Driven by compassion. Defined by expertise. Strengthened by collaboration. We empower communities to improve disaster outcomes and build lasting resilience.

VISION

In the true spirit of emergency management – ACDC seeks to solve crises, both for the communities and individuals affected by disasters as well as for the clients we serve. title: Software Engineer - AI Workflows (m/f/d)
description:
The Company

At EnOcean, we are passionate about driving innovation and creating IoT solutions that positively impact our world. We have pioneered batteryless, energy-harvesting wireless sensors and built platforms that enable efficient sensing, tracking, and data-driven solutions across industries such as building automation, logistics, healthcare, and industrial IoT.

Our platforms combine large-scale data processing with AI-enabled analytics and automation to deliver reliable, user- and customer-centric solutions. We focus on transforming complex telemetry and operational data from energy-efficient devices and connected systems into actionable insights while ensuring transparency, robustness, and long-term maintainability.

Operating in an environment that prioritizes security, data protection, and the responsible use of advanced technologies, including AI, is integral to how we design, build, and operate our systems.

#LI-Hybrid

The Role & You

We develop wireless sensor technology for smart buildings, and AI runs through both our products and the company behind them. You will work on two fronts: the AI algorithms at the heart of our products, and the AI workflows that make everyday work across the whole organization smarter and faster.

This is a hands-on builder role. We are not looking for a prompt operator, and not for a data scientist — we are looking for someone who understands the technology and builds with it. Students, recent graduates, and early-career engineers are welcome.

This position can be based in either Munich, Germany, or Utrecht, the Netherlands. We are recruiting for one role and will hire one candidate. The employment contract will be concluded with the local EnOcean entity at the selected location. Please apply only once and indicate your preferred location.

How to apply

We want to see how you think and build. Instead of a traditional CV, submit a presentation of an AI project you built yourself — what you built, why, and how it works:

  • A video recording (max. 10 minutes — recommended)
  • A written document with diagrams and code samples
  • A public repository with a detailed README

Applications without a project presentation cannot be considered.

What you’ll be doing

  • Develop and improve the AI algorithms inside our products — the models and analytics that turn sensor data into insight.
  • Build automated AI workflows that take recurring manual work off people’s plates.
  • Bring AI into our systems of record — CRM, ERP, HR, quality, ticketing — together with the people who own those processes.
  • Prototype quickly, keep what works, and turn it into shared company infrastructure.

What we’re looking for

  • Solid scripting in Python or JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Hands-on experience automating workflows and connecting tools through APIs.
  • A working grasp of models, data, and agents — enough to reasonabouttrade-offs.
  • Completed AI projects you can walk us through end to end — they matter more to us than degrees or years of experience.

What we offer and what you can expect

Stability

Enjoy the security as well as long-term prospects and become part of our growing company that drives innovation since 2001.

Empowerment & Autonomy

At EnOcean, your ideas matter. We give you the freedom to innovate, take initiative, and actively shape the future of technology.

Professional Development

We actively support your continuous growth through training, workshops, and certifications, empowering you to expand your skills and advance your career.

Flexible Working Hours & Remote Working

EnOcean offers flexible working hours and the option to work remotely. Our supportive culture actively promotes a healthy work-life balance, giving you ample space for family, hobbies, and personal well-being.

Technology

We support your work environment, ensuring you have the modern equipment and conditions you need for comfortable and productive work.

Fantastic colleagues

A collaborative, highly skilled and motivated engineering culture.


About us

Together at UndagridWe want to change how business sees, and does logistical processes across the entire chain with cutting-edge technological solutions. Working at Undagrid means that you’ll be surrounded by colleagues who are constantly pushing boundaries and thinking two steps ahead of the curve, while always making time for a laugh. When we build, we are constantly looking for fresh ways to think for new solutions to new problems. Our values shape everything we think and do:

We are AdaptiveThis keeps us flexible in thinking, and future-proof. No problem is too complex.

We are PioneeringAs pioneers, we choose to break ground with new solutions—it keeps us energized.

We are CuriousThis attitude of curiosity is about wanting to know more, and know further, and lives in everything we do.

description:
Who We Are

At ERC Pathlight, we’re on a mission to change lives—and we’re looking for people who feel called to do the same.

As one of the nation’s leading treatment providers for eating disorders and mood, anxiety, and trauma-related conditions, we bring innovative, evidence-based, and deeply compassionate care to patients across the country. With multiple locations nationwide and extensive virtual programming, we meet patients exactly where they are and help them move toward lasting recovery.

Founded in 2008 by renowned psychiatrists and psychologists, ERC Pathlight now supports more than 6,000 patients each year. And as the need for world-class mental health care continues to rise, our commitment is stronger than ever: to expand access, elevate the standard of care, and empower every patient to rebuild their life with dignity and hope.

Why Join Us

When you join ERC Pathlight, you become part of a team that shows up every day to make a real difference. You’ll work alongside passionate clinicians, dedicated support staff, and mission-driven leaders who believe in collaboration, growth, and doing the right thing—always.

Here, your work matters. Your ideas matter. You matter.

If you’re energized by purpose, motivated by impact, and ready to help transform the future of mental health treatment, you belong here.

Come build hope. Come save lives. Come grow with us.

What you’ll be doing:

Schedule:Fulltime NOC PC 6:30pm-7am Tue/Fri/Sun

The Program Coordinator (PC I, PC II, PC III) is responsible for providing direct care and supervision to patients within inpatient, residential, and partial hospitalization levels of care at ERC Pathlight. Program Coordinators maintain a safe, structured, and therapeutic milieu while supporting the implementation of individualized treatment plans.

PCs provide patient supervision, maintain structure and boundaries, support therapeutic programming, assist with mealtime support, and complete required documentation. Level placement (I, II, III) is determined based on education, experience, and demonstrated competency.

Essential duties and responsibilities:

  • Milieu Management
  • Maintain daily program structure by following the established schedule
  • Complete observation rounds and safety checks as ordered by physician
  • Support patients with de-escalation and implementation of coping skills per treatment plan
  • Conduct room and luggage searches
  • Supervise fresh air breaks and mindful movement exposures
  • Provide ongoing bathroom monitoring
  • Obtain and document patient vital signs, weights, and urine specific gravity (as applicable by location/program)
  • Group Facilitation
  • Participate in facilitation of therapeutic groups
  • Complete required EHR documentation related to group facilitation
  • Support group-based social activities and meal outings
  • Meal Support
  • Participate in all meals and snacks with patients
  • Provide meal support using coaching and skills aligned with the treatment team
  • Complete timely and accurate meal-related documentation
  • Support dietitians in preparation for Nutrition and Cooking Groups
  • Ensure adherence to individualized meal plans and allergy-safety protocols
  • Support restaurant outings as needed
  • Administrative & Operational Support
  • Complete required documentation in compliance with organizational and regulatory standards, including patient observations, meals, and shift-related events
  • Provide patient transportation for medical appointments (as applicable by location/program)
  • Support additional transportation needs including outings, grocery procurement, or other facility needs
  • Assist with food procurement as needed (may occur weekly)
  • Distribute mail and packages daily

Position Expectations (All Levels)

  • All Program Coordinators must:
  • Be willing and able to work at all ERC Pathlight local sites as assigned
  • Be compliant with certification and regulatory requirements for each practice location
  • Maintain a flexible schedule to meet organizational staffing needs
  • Be available to work weekends and holidays as required
  • Be available to work on-call shifts based on business needs and in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local labor laws

Must haves:

Program Coordinator I (PC I)

  • High School Diploma or GED (Required)
  • Entry-level role: no prior direct patient care experience required unless required by state regulation (Required)
  • Valid driver’s license with safe driving record: required only at locations operating company vehicles or requiring driving on behalf of the company (Required)
  • Washington teammates must hold a state credential (may be pending at time of hire) (Required)
  • ServSafe certification may be required depending on state and local licensing regulations (Required)
  • Mental Health/Psych Tech or CNA certification (Preferred)

Program Coordinator II (PC II)

  • High School Diploma or GED (Required)
  • Minimum of one (1) year of direct patient care experience (Required)
  • Valid driver’s license with safe driving record: required only at locations operating company vehicles or requiring driving on behalf of the company (Required)
  • Washington teammates must hold a state credential (may be pending at time of hire) (Required)
  • ServSafe certification may be required depending on state and local licensing regulations (Required)
  • Mental Health/Psych Tech or CAN certification (Preferred)

Program Coordinator III (PC III)

  • Bachelor’s degree in behavioral health or related field (Required)
  • Minimum of six (6) months of experience in a behavioral health or related field (Required)
  • Valid driver’s license with safe driving record: required only at locations operating company vehicles or requiring driving on behalf of the company (Required)
  • Washington teammates must hold a state credential (may be pending at time of hire) (Required)
  • ServSafe certification may be required depending on state and local licensing regulations (Required)
  • Mental Health/Psych Tech or CAN certification (Preferred)

#ERC

Illinois Pay Range
$18.25—$29 USD

What We Offer

At ERC Pathlight, caring for people is our mission and that begins with caring for our own team. Your well-being matters, and our benefit program is designed to support every part of your life.

We offer competitive compensation; comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage; generous Paid Time Off; Parental Leave benefits; Retirement benefits; and tuition reimbursement to help you continue growing in your career.

We also recognize that mental health is part of every person’s experience. That’s why we strive to create a workplace where you feel supported, seen, and encouraged—personally, professionally, and at home.

When you thrive, you can do your best work. And your best work changes lives.

Job Description
LG Electronics' Information Display Division is seeking a Technical Product & Solutions Manager – Networks & Security to join our rapidly growing Software Solutions business at our office in Lincolnshire, IL. This is an in-office position (5 days/week).


The Technical Product & Solutions Manager – Networks & Security will serve as LG's subject matter expert for enterprise networking, network administration, and information security as they relate to the deployment and integration of LG's digital signage hardware and cloud-based Remote Monitoring & Management (RMS) and Content Management System (CMS) software in Enterprise, Operational Technology (OT), Retail, Healthcare, Transportation, and Government environments.


This is not an internal IT position administering LG's internal infrastructure. Instead, you will represent LG while working directly with customers' IT, network engineering, network administration, and information security teams to ensure successful deployment, integration, security, and ongoing operation of LG commercial display solutions.
The ideal candidate combines strong product management capabilities with deep hands-on experience in enterprise networking, network administration, cybersecurity, customer-facing technical consulting, and solution architecture.


Principal Responsibilities
• Lead the networking and security integration of LG software solutions with customer IT and network infrastructure.
• Act as the primary networking and cybersecurity subject matter expert for enterprise customers, system integrators, and internal teams.
• Work directly with customer network administrators and network engineering teams to design, validate, and troubleshoot connectivity for LG digital signage deployments.
• Recommend cybersecurity best practices, network architecture standards, and security policies for customers deploying LG digital signage solutions.
• Author system and software requirements specifications related to networking, authentication, encryption, security, and compliance for Product Planning and R&D teams.
• Assist customers in debugging, troubleshooting, and resolving networking, communication, authentication, and security issues in production environments.
• Analyze and troubleshoot issues involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, VLANs, Wi-Fi, VPNs, firewalls, proxies, multicast traffic, and cloud connectivity.
• Maintain, administer, troubleshoot, and continuously improve LG's local lab and demonstration network environments, including switches, routers, wireless infrastructure, VLANs, firewalls, VPNs, and security controls used for product validation, interoperability testing, proof-of-concept activities, customer demonstrations, and engineering development.
• Design, implement, and document lab network architectures that accurately emulate customer enterprise environments to support testing, troubleshooting, security validation, and product development initiatives.
• Evaluate and deploy new networking and security technologies within the lab environment to support next-generation LG software and hardware solutions.
• Support customer security reviews, risk assessments, architecture reviews, and vendor security questionnaires.
• Strengthen LG's software business competitiveness through discovery of new technologies, proof-of-concept initiatives, and evaluation of emerging networking and cybersecurity solutions.
• Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Product Planning, and R&D to develop next-generation secure software solutions that align with evolving industry networking and security standards.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with customers by understanding their business objectives, technical environments, and operational challenges.
• Generate proposals, presentations, technical documentation, and customer-facing materials that effectively communicate LG's networking and security capabilities and value proposition.
• Work closely with Sales and Business Development teams to ensure successful onboarding, deployment, and long-term customer success.
• Perform SWOT analysis of LG commercial display products and cloud SaaS solutions with respect to networking, security, device management, and enterprise integration capabilities.
• Monitor industry trends, competitive offerings, and emerging technologies in networking, cybersecurity, SaaS, OT, and IoT environments.
• Support customer onboarding, product demonstrations, technical training sessions, webinars, trade shows, and industry events.

Required Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
• Minimum of 8 years of hands-on experience in enterprise network administration, network engineering, network architecture, network operations, or enterprise cybersecurity.
• Demonstrated experience designing, administering, troubleshooting, and securing enterprise network infrastructure.
• Hands-on experience administering enterprise network infrastructure including switches, routers, firewalls, wireless networks, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, and network monitoring solutions.
• Experience building, maintaining, and troubleshooting test, development, or lab network environments used for validation, demonstrations, or engineering purposes.
• Direct experience with IAM, PKI, SSO, EDR/XDR, Authentication, Encryption, Certificate Management, MDM, or Device Provisioning.
• In-depth understanding of TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, Routing and Switching, Multicast Networking, Wi-Fi Technologies, Firewalls, VPN Technologies, RESTful APIs, and Network Monitoring.

• Experience administering or supporting enterprise networking platforms from Cisco, Juniper, Aruba, HPE, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Meraki, or equivalent.
• Strong network troubleshooting skills including packet capture and protocol analysis using Wireshark, tcpdump, or equivalent.
• Ability to debug complex networking, communication, authentication, and cloud connectivity issues across distributed environments.
• Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
• Strong analytical, technical, and problem-solving capabilities.
• Ability to communicate effectively with both highly technical stakeholders and executive audiences.
• Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 10% of the time.


Preferred Qualifications
• Industrial OT and IoT cybersecurity experience.
• SaaS, PaaS, cloud infrastructure, and data orchestration experience.
• Experience supporting large-scale endpoint deployments and device management platforms.
• Experience with Zero Trust architectures and modern enterprise security frameworks.
• Professional certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CISSP, CISM, Security+, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Aruba, or equivalent.
• Product management experience supporting enterprise software, cloud platforms, networking products, or cybersecurity solutions.

title: Global Director of Strategic Communications
description:
Global Director of Strategic Communications

Location: Global - remote - we encourage applications from candidates from any location that are comfortable working at times during European hours.

The opportunity

This is a rare opportunity to build the public-influence infrastructure for one of the most important gaps in the climate and environmental movement: how to make care for the environment credible, visible and mainstream among conservative and traditional audiences globally.

Our Common Home (OCH) works through independent local organisations in around 19 countries. These partners engage people with a strong attachment to the land, traditions and communities – audiences who have often felt alienated by the tone and politics of mainstream climate advocacy. The role of the Global Director of Strategic Communications is to help credible local voices be heard, trusted and repeated in the places where public and political opinion is formed.

The postholder will build OCH's central public-influence capability - known internally as media engagement - from the ground up. They will establish the standards, systems, methods and shared infrastructure that allow national teams to strengthen their own media and public-influence work. In the early phase, the role will be hands-on with priority countries. Over time, the work will shift deliberately from delivery to coaching, with the capability embedded in the network rather than held at the centre.

About OCH

OCH increases support for protecting the environment by empowering those who are currently left out of the conversation. It works through independent local organisations in around 19 countries, supporting local actors to take environmental action rooted in more mainstream values and interests.

It works by:

  • developing better, longer-lasting solutions that reflect the priorities of ordinary people;

  • creating the space for decision-makers from across the political spectrum to lead on environmental issues on their own terms; and

  • building confidence, capability and credibility in places where environmental action has too often been framed as belonging to one side of politics.

OCH’s model depends on local credibility. Country teams know their audiences, politics, language and media environments best. The central team exists to strengthen that work, not to direct it. A small global team sets the mission and supports country teams on strategy, research, governance and fundraising.

Why this role matters now

The media and information environment is changing fast. Trust is fragmenting, audiences are harder to reach through traditional channels, and AI is reshaping how information is produced, discovered, summarised and repeated. Generic content is losing value. The premium is moving towards trusted voices, credible data, distinctive insight and rapid relevance.

That shift plays to OCH's strengths, but only if the network is built for where media is heading rather than where it has been. The successful candidate will help OCH partners build the infrastructure to build up credible voices, develop them, connect them to the right media and platforms, and ensure their stories and evidence travel across the network.

Purpose of the role

The Global Director of Strategic Communications will build and lead OCH's central strategic communications and public-influence function. The role will define what good media engagement work looks like across the network, support countries to develop their own capacity, and create shared systems that allow learning, intelligence and media opportunities to travel quickly.

The consistent priority is to amplify partners and credible local voices rather than to raise OCH's own profile. The postholder will have the authority, licence and resources to build the infrastructure needed to do that well.

The role works across three levels

  • Partner and spokesperson amplification. Elevating credible conservative and centre-right voices already rooted in communities through the network's partners and ground game, led by local people and local stories.

  • Country entity communications. Helping national entities develop their own public presence, earned-media capacity, spokesperson base and public-influence strategy, without taking ownership of their political positioning.

  • OCH central communications. Developing the strategy for OCH's own public profile where it is useful to the mission, while keeping the primary emphasis on the network and local voices.

What success looks like

After the first year, success would mean that OCH has a clear media engagement strategy, a small but effective central capability, shared standards and methods, a tested spokesperson-development process, priority-country plans, and a growing rapid-response model.

After three years, success would mean that country teams have the tools, confidence, relationships and judgement to lead their own public-influence work; credible conservative and centre-right environmental voices are more visible in national debates across priority countries; and the centre has moved from doing the work to advising, coaching and strengthening it.

Key responsibilities

  • Build OCH's central strategic communications and public-influence capability, including shaping the team, external support and operating model required for the build phase.

  • Define what good media engagement work looks like across the network: the shared language, standards, frameworks and practical tools that country teams can adapt to their contexts.

  • Work directly with country teams in the early phase to develop their strategies, then move progressively into a coaching and advisory role as country capacity grows.

  • Develop a network-wide spokesperson methodology: how country teams identify, prepare, support and sustain credible voices over time.

  • Build a rapid-response capability so credible local voices can become part of relevant breaking stories in a timely way.

  • Create shared infrastructure for narrative testing, media monitoring, intelligence gathering and cross-network learning, so that good practice travels quickly.

  • Position OCH's voices, stories and data for an AI-shaped media environment, including how information is found, summarised, trusted and reused.

  • Help country teams map and build relationships with the outlets, validators, think tanks, creators and platforms that reach their audiences.

  • Lead on developing crisis response protocols

  • Manage a budget focused mainly on developing capacity and skills across the network

  • Plan the handover from the start: define the milestones at which central support reduces, what country teams need to demonstrate before taking fuller ownership, and how the function moves to a lighter-touch model.

The wider ambition

Beyond the foundational systems, this role carries a larger strategic opportunity. OCH is well placed to build much needed new public-influence infrastructure. That could include a global or regional network of conservative environmental spokespeople, country-level mapping of the outlets and validators that shape non-progressive audiences, new media partnerships, or even the creation of platforms and formats that engage these audiences seriously. Not all of these ideas will prove viable. The postholder will have room to test these ideas, the judgement to decide which are worth pursuing, and the discipline to stop the ones that are not working.

What sits with country teams

OCH's ethos is rooted in the belief that those closest to the work are best placed to devise and deliver the strategy. The Global Director of Strategic Communications will not own national political positioning, decisions about who speaks publicly in each country, campaign priorities and timing, national media relationships, or the specific language of media engagement work in each context.

The credibility of the work depends on it being and feeling genuinely local. The role requires authority without directiveness: the ability to set standards, challenge constructively and build capability while leaving ownership where it belongs.

Person specification

Essential

  • Senior strategic communications judgement. The ability to see how media, politics, audiences, narratives and organisational strategy connect.

  • Media-operator credibility. Recent, hands-on experience of placing stories, developing spokespeople, managing narratives and working with journalists, editors, creators or platforms at pace.

  • Builder instinct. The appetite and ability to create infrastructure from scratch, without an established playbook.

  • Coaching orientation. A genuine commitment to developing others' capability rather than defaulting to doing the work personally.

  • Political fluency. Strong understanding of centre-right and conservative landscapes, and the credibility to engage the validators and spokespeople the network needs to reach.

  • Network orchestration. The ability to work across many country contexts, with the cultural judgement to adapt without losing coherence.

  • AI and media change. Current, practical interest in how AI is reshaping the way information is produced, found and trusted, and what that means for strategic communications.

  • Temperament. The ability to bring authority and judgement, but not ego. Able to set clear standards, challenge when needed, and still let country teams own their work.

  • Professional proficiency in English (CEFR C2 or equivalent).

Desirable

  • Experience of building, spinning out or scaling a new entity, function or practice.

  • Experience of multi-country civil-society networks, international NGOs or politically diverse coalitions.

  • Experience in climate, environment, energy, land, rural affairs or adjacent public-policy debates.

  • Experience working with philanthropic funders, boards or senior political stakeholders.

What this role is not

This is not a conventional head of communications role. It is not a content-production function, not a press office, not a brand role for OCH, and not a command-and-control role directing what country teams say.

Candidates whose strength lies mainly in running an established communications operation may find the role frustrating. The successful candidate will be someone who wants to build a capability, prove its value, embed it in others and then deliberately let it go.

Terms

Reports to: Chief Strategy Officer, working closely with the CEO.

Team and resources: The postholder will be expected to shape the team, external support and budget required for the build out, in discussion with the CEO and Chief Strategy Officer.

Hours of work: Some overlap with European working hours will be helpful during the intensive early phase, when the role works closely with Europe-based leadership.

What we offer

A competitive remuneration package, including health insurance, pension contributions and other benefits appropriate to the successful candidate's location.
