title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
About PredictHQ

AI and forecasting systems have a blind spot: the real-world conditions that shift demand land as surprises instead of signals. PredictHQ closes that gap.

PredictHQ is the real-world context platform powering enterprise AI decisions, trusted by the world's largest enterprises, including Uber, Domino's and Accor. We explain more than 60 per cent of real-world demand variability, grounding models in verified spatial, temporal and economic reality so businesses can make high-stakes decisions on pricing, staffing and inventory with confidence.

With Beam, our relevancy engine, Bolt, our rapid integration framework, and native MCP support for AI agent workflows, we're defining a new category at the intersection of AI, data and enterprise decision-making. We're a company in motion, backed by strong fundamentals and hard technical problems.

Founded in 2016 and backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sutter Hill Ventures, and Aspect Ventures, PredictHQ has offices in Auckland and San Francisco.

Our Values

PredictHQ is about teamwork to achieve huge things. We are building innovative and complex products, so our empathetic, hard-working culture is key to our success. We are proactive in helping our teammates grow and thrive in their careers, as well as making sure everyone can put their family and friends first.

Job purpose 🎯

We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our Project team: a senior group of data scientists and engineers responsible for building and running the machine learning models that power how our customers understand and act on demand.

You'll be working with a unique combination of real-world context tracked globally, paired with real demand data - bookings, footfall, spend - from businesses across retail, hospitality, accommodation and transportation, at a scale nobody else has matched. That combination is what lets you build the models and systems behind our API-first products, giving global brands the ability to see not just what happens next, but why demand moves - so they can build that intelligence directly into their own forecasting, pricing and inventory systems. You'd be building the intelligence that powers enterprise AI decisions.

In this role, you'll own turning proven data science models into production-grade DS libraries and deploying them into our production environment - ensuring they run reliably at scale. You'll thrive here if you enjoy solving the challenging problems of production ML, including reliability, scalability, and integrating research-grade work into systems that withstand real-world loads.

You'll work hands-on with Python and our ML platform and infrastructure, using AI tools actively as part of how you build and ship. You'll work closely with our data scientists day to day, and contribute to the production libraries the team relies on.

What you'll do 🔑

  • Convert data science models and proofs-of-concept into production-grade ML libraries

  • Design, build and maintain large-scale ML pipelines from research through to serving

  • Validate that production libraries return the same results as the offline research models

  • Deploy models into production roughly every project cycle, working closely with the wider engineering team

  • Own the reliability and scalability of models once they're live

  • Work alongside data scientists during the research phase - feature engineering and offline testing

  • Contribute to and help evolve our MLE frameworks and engineering best practices

  • Mentor data scientists on building models that deploy more easily, and learn from them in return

  • Build models yourself where it makes sense (a smaller part of the role)

What you'll bring ⭐️

  • Expert-level Python, with hands-on experience deploying and maintaining production ML systems - not just building or prototyping them

  • Experience with distributed ML infrastructure - model serving (e.g., Ray Serve, SageMaker) and production ML pipelines

  • Experience with MLOps practices - CI/CD, automated pipeline testing, and model versioning/experiment tracking (e.g., MLflow)

  • 4-5 years of engineering experience across software engineering, data engineering, and/or ML engineering

  • Strong software engineering methodology and best practices

  • Comfortable in a highly collaborative environment (standups, two-way code review, mentoring), and an active user of AI tools in your own work

  • Curiosity about frontier model architectures - we're building some of the most advanced models in the space; fast-moving tech or startup background preferred

General

  • Applicants for this position must have New Zealand residency or a valid New Zealand work visa.

  • Ensure that all activities are conducted in accordance with internal policies and procedures, applicable legislation, rules and standards, including relevant Acts, Advertising Standards Authority rules and regulations, and industry body requirements.

  • Based in Auckland, this role follows our hybrid approach, combining the flexibility of working from home with at least two days a week in the office to foster team connection and collaboration.

Benefits 💛

  • Health Insurance administered by Unimed

  • Paid Birthday Leave and Paid Family and Friends Day Leave

  • Strong focus on your training and development

  • 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave

  • Flexible work arrangements

  • A hybrid work environment centred on collaboration, agility and fun

  • Options in a fast-growing company in its early stages

  • $500 annual stipend to support your work-from-home setup

title: Software Development Engineer (Java & AWS), Ring
description:
Ring is looking for a passionate and talented Software Development Engineer who will help us create the next generation of apps, and services. You will be responsible for developing cloud services and applications that interact seamlessly with our devices and delight our customers. In this role, you will work closely with a cross-functional team of engineers, and product managers to design, test, learn, and iterate on solutions in a fast-paced environment. You will build low-latency systems with the required uptime of a security system. You will also get to work alongside a talented team, invested in making each other successful, as well as building revolutionary features for our products.

You will join a team that owns the most important place in the Ring - Setup experience. This area is the first user’s interaction with Ring so we’re laser focused on ensuring a smooth set up and a great customer experience. This role is a great opportunity to shape the setup process experience for millions of users.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and document distributed systems and microservices.
- Implement robust and maintainable code with clear and maintained documentation.
- Deliver customer value in iterative fashion while working towards longer term systems to solve roadmap goals with increasing efficiency.
- Communicate status and changes to the work they are responsible and accountable for, keep all stakeholders informed of changes and updates to original plan.
- Implement test automation on all code implemented through unit testing and integration testing.
- Leverage generative AI tools and techniques to enhance development productivity, code quality, and system design while maintaining security and compliance standards.

A day in the life
This role provides a unique opportunity to be a key part in shaping the core of Ring's offerings to our customers. You will work across teams to prototype ideas and solve complex problems, and raise the bar of our applications by advocating and driving software best practices, automating tasks and identifying pitfalls. As part of the team, you will continue to learn and become an expert in challenging fields. You will have the opportunity to contribute your creative ideas and energy, working with world-class experts, distributed cloud systems and home security devices.

About the team
Working on exciting new features and fully owning some of the most visited and core experiences in the Ring software, our team is always looking to learn and innovate. Our team works across mobile, backend, and cloud infrastructure to deliver high-quality, end-to-end solutions. We frequently collaborate with firmware, other cloud and mobile teams to solve problems, come up with solutions and delight our customers. We are data driven, value and promote ownership, working backwards from our customers to bring them an innovative and seamless home security experience.

- Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
- Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers

title: FIX Onboarding & Client Services
description:
FIX Onboarding & Client Services, EMEA

Hybrid, London, UK (3+ days per week in-office) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles billions in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 35+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We are seeking a motivated and technically skilled Onboarding and Client Services professional to join our London team. This role will focus on FIX client onboarding, integrations, and client service delivery across FX, equities and digital assets. The successful candidate will work closely with clients and internal teams to ensure seamless connectivity, smooth integration, and exceptional service throughout the client lifecycle.

What You’ll Work On

FIX Onboarding & Integrations

  • Lead and manage FIX client onboarding projects — from initial requirements gathering through certification and production go-live.

  • Configure, test, and validate FIX sessions, including order routing, execution reporting, and market data flows.

  • Coordinate conformance testing and certification with clients to ensure compliance with platform standards.

  • Document onboarding procedures, client configurations, and integration best practices.

  • Leverage internal AI and automation tools to streamline client onboarding and troubleshooting

  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to support new FIX workflows, APIs, and client integration initiatives.

Client Services

  • Serve as a frontline technical support for clients in EMEA across FX and equities business lines.

  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, ensuring timely and transparent communication addressing their needs and queries with professionalism and efficiency.

  • Provide ongoing technical and operational support for production trading environments.

  • Manage client inquiries, troubleshoot workflow or configuration issues, and coordinate resolutions across internal teams.

  • Partner with account management, sales and product teams to ensure a positive client experience and successful delivery of platform enhancements.

What We Need

  • 3+ years of experience in a client onboarding, integration, or technical support role within a financial technology, trading, or brokerage environment.

  • Strong working knowledge of the FIX protocol — message structures, session management, and common trading workflows — with the ability to actually explain why a given configuration or workflow serves the client's business outcome, not just execute it.

  • Proven experience troubleshooting FIX connectivity, analysing logs, and resolving integration issues.

  • Familiarity with FX and Equities trading environments, order lifecycle management, and market data connectivity — genuine interest in working across multiple asset classes rather than staying within one.

  • Comfortable with (or curious about) automation and AI-assisted tooling in an operational context — this role uses internal AI/automation to streamline onboarding and troubleshooting, so a mindset that embraces efficiency over manual repetition matters more than any specific tool.

  • Excellent communication and organisational skills, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple onboarding/client projects in parallel.

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience with OMS/EMS platforms, liquidity aggregators, or trading system integrations.

  • Exposure to other API protocols and architectures (REST, WebSocket) — relevant given the depth of our own API.

  • Scripting or automation experience (e.g. Python) and familiarity with monitoring tools (Splunk, Grafana, or similar).

  • Understanding of financial market structure and post-trade workflows.

What You Get

  • A genuinely rich API to work with — not a thin FIX wrapper bolted onto a legacy system. You'll onboard clients onto an API with real depth across order routing, execution reporting, and market data — the kind of platform where understanding the protocol properly actually matters.

  • Breadth across FX, Equities, and digital assets — most FIX/onboarding roles sit inside a single asset class. Here you'll build knowledge across all three, at a network connecting 40+ liquidity providers — exposure that compounds faster than a single-product environment.

  • Real ownership of the tech-to-business bridge — you're not just configuring sessions, you're the person translating FIX/API detail into client outcomes clients actually care about. That combination — technical credibility plus commercial judgement, is the actual shape of this role.

  • A genuinely tech-first operation — we lean on internal AI and automation to cut the manual grind out of onboarding and troubleshooting, so your time goes toward the client and integration problems that need real judgement, not repetitive configuration work.

  • A small, senior team — you'll work directly alongside Client Services, TechOps, and engineering, with real visibility into how the platform works end to end, not a large layer of process between you and the people who built it.

  • Growth across the business — the skills this role builds (protocol depth, client-facing technical credibility, cross-asset exposure) are the same ones that open doors internally.

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition
Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Team Conversation with one or two members of the Client Services team
Format: Video call or In-person, interactive session, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Leadership Conversation with CRO

Format: Video call or In-person, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our .

description:
About the role:

The Senior Information Officer supports the effective management and use of information and content across the department, ensuring information practices align with governance, policy and compliance requirements while enabling productivity and modern ways of working.

The role applies information management standards and guidance in practical contexts, working closely with business areas, digital and IT teams to improve how information is created, structured, accessed and used. This includes supporting information readiness for digital platforms, collaboration tools and emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence. The role provides strategic leadership, governance and authoritative advice to support service delivery.

Working under the direction of the Principal Information and Emerging Technology, the role provides hands‑on advisory support, contributes to capability uplift and helps translate information policy and guidance into everyday practice across the organisation.

Please view position description for further information about the role.

About us:

At the Victorian Department of Health we want a future where Victorians are the healthiest people in the world. A Victoria where our children and people thrive, our workplaces are productive and safe, and our communities are more connected.

We see it as our job to support Victorians to stay healthy and safe. And to deliver a world-class healthcare system that ensures every single Victorian can access safe, quality care that leads to better health outcomes for all.

About you:

  • Applies information and content management frameworks, standards and guidance to support consistent and compliant information practices across the department.

  • Supports experimentation and continuous improvement within agreed governance and risk settings.

  • Builds effective working relationships across business, digital and IT teams.

  • Provides information management input to initiatives involving new tools, platforms or changes to information use.

Qualification/Specialist Experitse

  • Tertiary qualification in information management, information technology, digital disciplines or a related field is desirable.
  • Demonstrated experience applying information and content management practices, standards or guidance in a complex organisational environment is required.

What we offer:

  • The opportunity to perform meaningful work, making direct contributions toward enabling Victorians to be the healthiest people in the world.
  • A wide range of growth and development opportunities within the department and wider Victorian Public Service.
  • A strong commitment to work-life balance, including a diverse array of flexible working arrangements.

How to apply:

Applications should include a resume and a cover letter. Click the ‘Apply' button to view further information about the role including key contact details and the advertisement closing date.

We are committed to developing and supporting a workforce that is well equipped and highly motivated to provide responsive and quality services to all Victorians. We continue to build an inclusive workplace that embraces diversity of backgrounds and differences to realise the potential of our employees for innovation and delivering services aimed at enhancing the lives of all Victorians. All roles can be worked flexibly and we encourage applications from Aboriginal people, people with disability, LGBTIQ+ and people from culturally diverse backgrounds. Please contact us if you require any adjustments to participate in the recruitment process at inclusion@health.vic.gov.au. For more information on our commitment to inclusion and diversity see inclusion and diversity at the Department of Health.

If you have any queries in relation to participation in recruitment processes at Health, or experience any issues in applying, please feel free to email talentacquisition@health.vic.gov.au. Please note that unsolicited applications from third parties cannot be accepted. If you have questions regarding the role, please message the contact person listed on the advertisement directly.

Preferred applicants may be required to complete a police check and other pre-employment checks. Information provided will be treated in line with our Privacy Policy.

title: Partner Solutions Engineer, EMEA
description:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next.

For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents.

We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next.

About the role:

We are looking for a Senior Partner Solutions Engineer to join our partnerships team in EMEA. This role will lead enablement and pre-sales motions with Vercel's solution and consulting partners (SIs and GSIs) across the region, with a primary focus on the DACH market. Partner Solutions Engineers work with partner engineering, sales, and product teams to grow adoption of Vercel's products and build strong technical relationships.

A key focus in this role will be growing partner-delivered capacity in the DACH region: running Vercel's partner certification program, creating and delivering technical enablement and workshops, and supporting pre-sales motions where partners are engaged. Fluency in German and/or French is essential; this is a spoken, partner-facing role.

This role will serve as a developer advocate for Vercel across solution and consulting partners. You will be the expert on building and delivering with Vercel products, including AI and agent workloads, and will establish best practices, author guides, lead workshops and hackathons, and build solutions for partner communities and Vercel teams.

Partner Solutions Engineers require a strong web development background, especially in frontend development, cloud infrastructure, networking, and modern application development. Strong coordination skills across multiple partners and time zones are essential, as is building lasting relationships with practice leads, delivery teams, and executives.

This is an in-person (hybrid) position that will require you to be based in Vercel's London or Berlin office with a required 3 days per week in office.

What you will do:

  • Serve as subject matter expert on Vercel and Next.js to partner engineering teams and leadership across EMEA.
  • Run Vercel's partner certification program in the region: deliver certification workshops, review certification projects, and guide partner engineers through the program.
  • Create and deliver technical training and enablement on Next.js and Vercel best practices, including building agents and AI applications on Vercel.
  • Deliver one-to-many technical workshops for partner engineering teams, and author the workshop content behind them.
  • Run and support partner hackathons that build partner skills and surface joint solutions.
  • Provide pre-sales support where partners are engaged: proofs of concept, technical deep dives, and deal unblocking alongside Vercel's sales and sales engineering teams.
  • Serve as the main technical contact for SIs and GSIs in the region, building lasting relationships with their engineering teams and practice leadership.
  • Build templates and solutions that equip partner communities with the best practices on delivering with Vercel.

About you:

  • You are passionate about building first-class user experiences on the web.
  • You have a strong understanding of web architecture, frontend development, and serverless computing.
  • You have 4+ years of experience as a solutions engineer advising or consulting engineering teams.
  • You have 6+ years of experience building and launching frontend applications using Next.js or React.
  • You speak German and/or French; spoken fluency in at least one of them, alongside professional English, is essential for this role.
  • You have worked with or within agencies, systems integrators, or consulting firms, and understand how they staff, deliver, and grow a technology practice.
  • You are experienced in developer relations, from training sessions and talks to producing technical content.
  • You have a results-driven mindset and are experienced working in a fast-paced environment.
  • You are comfortable working with remote, globally distributed cross-functional teams.
  • You have excellent communication skills and experience building and maintaining strong relationships with stakeholders.
  • You have experience driving the adoption of web technology or previous pre-sales experience.
  • You are based in EMEA and able to travel 20% of the time.

Bonus if you:

  • Have built and shipped AI-powered or agentic applications, ideally with the AI SDK.
  • Speak both German and French.
  • Have run certification, training, or enablement programs at scale.
  • Have experience with composable architectures (headless CMS, commerce, search, analytics) common in partner-delivered projects.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation package, including equity.
  • Inclusive Healthcare Package.
  • Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
  • Flexible Time Off.
  • We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

Software Engineer - Full Stack Development - SC Cleared

Location: Hybrid - Farnborough
Salary: Up to £65,000

To apply, email: dominic.barbet@searchability.com

Join a Team Delivering Secure Technology Solutions

A technology-focused engineering team delivering secure software solutions is looking for a Software Engineer to join a collaborative environment working on modern applications and scalable backend systems.

This role offers the opportunity to contribute across the full software development lifecycle, working with modern front-end frameworks, backend services, containerisation, and DevOps tooling within secure environments.

The successful candidate will enjoy solving complex engineering challenges, contributing to technical discussions, and working closely with multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.

The Role

You'll work alongside software engineers, technical leads, and delivery teams to design, build, and maintain secure and scalable applications.

Responsibilities include:
* Collaborating with engineering teams to design, develop, and maintain software solutions
* Contributing across the full software development lifecycle including design, development, testing, and deployment
* Developing responsive front-end applications using JavaScript/TypeScript and React
* Designing and building backend services using Java, Python, or Go
* Using modern development and static analysis tools to support software quality
* Managing source code using Git and collaborative development workflows
* Working with Docker and containerised deployment environments
* Supporting CI/CD pipelines and automated software delivery processes
* Writing clean, maintainable, and well-documented code
* Participating in peer code reviews and technical discussions
* Contributing to engineering best practices and continuous improvement initiatives
* Keeping up to date with emerging technologies and modern development approaches

Required Skills & Experience

  • Commercial experience in software engineering or software development
    * Strong experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and React
    * Backend development experience using Java, Python, or Go
    * Experience using Git for version control and collaborative development
    * Understanding of software engineering principles, algorithms, and data structures
    * Experience with Docker and containerisation technologies
    * Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevOps practices
    * Strong communication and collaboration skills

title: Verkostoasentaja
description:
Liity joukkoomme verkostoasentajaksi Keski-Suomeen vakituiseen työsuhteeseen!

Omexom toimii Suomessa energianjakelun koko ketjun parissa tuotannosta siirto- ja jakeluverkkoihin. Tarjoamme avaimet käteen -projekteja, palveluita ja kunnossapitoa. Omexom työllistää noin 500 työntekijää ympäri Suomen.

Tehtäväsi on sähkönjakeluverkon rakentamisen, kunnossapidon ja 24/7-viankorjauksen tehtävät. Työtehtäviin kuuluvat 0,4/20 kV:n maakaapeli- ja ilmajohtoasennukset, viankorjaus, kunnossapitotyöt sekä pylvästyöt. Lisäksi tehtävään sisältyvät 20 kV:n ja 110 kV:n kytkentätyöt sekä töiden kirjaaminen ja dokumentointi työnantajan käytössä oleviin järjestelmiin.

Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä asiakkaiden ja alihankkijoiden kanssa. Tehtävään kuuluu myös osallistuminen varallaoloon.

Työhönottopaikka näissä tehtävissä on Jyväskylä, Saarijärvi tai Karstula.

Toivomme sinulta

· Tehtävään soveltuvaa koulutusta (esim. verkostoasentajan ammattitutkinto)

· Kokemusta sähköverkon rakentamiseen ja kunnossapitoon liittyvistä tehtävistä, mielellään useamman vuoden ajalta

· Turvallisuuslähtöistä ajattelutapaa ja sitoutumista turvallisiin työtapoihin

· Asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä ja hyviä yhteistyötaitoja

· Kykyä ottaa vastuuta omasta työstä sekä edistää asioita itsenäisesti

· Vähintään B-luokan ajokorttia

· Hyvää suullista suomen kielen taitoa

Työturvallisuus on toimintamme perusta ja odotamme sinulta sitoutumista turvallisiin työtapoihin sekä halua huolehtia niin omasta kuin työkavereiden turvallisuudesta jokaisena työpäivänä.

Työntekijänä olet positiivinen ja aktiivinen, tartut tehtäviin reippaalla asenteella ja teet yhteistyötä sujuvasti niin kollegoiden, asiakkaiden kuin muidenkin sidosryhmien kanssa. Viihdyt ulkoilmassa ja nautit monipuolisesta työstä vaihtelevissa sääolosuhteissa ympäri vuoden.

Meidän tiimissämme pääset osaksi ammattitaitoista ja rentoa työporukkaa. Kollegoilta saa tukea ja neuvoja, ja vahva yhteishenki näkyy arjen tekemisessä. Meillä jokainen on tärkeä ja arvostettu osa porukkaa.

Meillä Omexomilla toimintaa ohjaa viisi arvoa: luottamus, autonomia, vastuullisuus, yrittäjähenkisyys ja solidaarisuus. Ne näkyvät arjessamme – tavassamme tehdä töitä, kohdata toisemme ja kehittää yhteistä tulevaisuutta. Meillä arvostetaan hyvää tiimihenkeä, työn monipuolisuutta, yhdessä onnistumista sekä mahdollisuutta oppia uutta ja kehittyä. Jaamme osaamista, tuemme toisiamme ja rakennamme yhdessä kestävää tulevaisuutta.

Tarjoamme palkkaa, joka vastaa tehtävän vaativuutta ja omaa osaamistasi – reilusti ja läpinäkyvästi. Palkkauksen perustana on Sähköalan TES (Energia-ICT-Verkosto).

Meillä pääset työskentelemään yhteiskunnan toiminnan kannalta keskeisellä alalla ja osallistumaan energiamurroksen toteuttamiseen osana globaalia verkostoamme.

Tuntuuko tehtävä sinulle sopivalta? Kiinnostuitko mahdollisuudesta työskennellä meillä?

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten kannattaa toimia nopeasti! Täytä hakemus ja kerro tarkemmin itsestäsi ja osaamisestasi 30.8.2026 mennessä.

Lisätietoa tehtävästä antaa

10.–18.8. Laura Rossi 0407176085, laura.rossi@omexom.com

19.–28.8. Juho Skantz 0400561917, juho.skantz@omexom.com

Tietoa työnantajasta

Energia-alan jatkuvien muutosten keskellä Omexom auttaa asiakkaitaan saavuttamaan energiasiirtymän tavoitteet. Hyödyntäen laaja-alaista osaamistaan sähkö- ja kaasualalla, Omexom rakentaa vähähiilisiä energialähteitä, kehittää sähköverkkoa, edistää energian tehokasta käyttöä sekä toteuttaa innovatiivisia ja yhteistyöhön perustuvia ratkaisuja.

Projektimme ja palvelumme ovat suunnattuja energiantuottajille, siirto- ja jakeluverkkoyhtiöille, paikallis- ja alueviranomaisille sekä niiden käyttäjille kaikilla alueilla. Omexom etsii jatkuvasti parhaita teknologisia vaihtoehtoja ja toteuttaa asiakkailleen soveltuvimmat ratkaisut täysin riippumattomana toimittajista.

Omexom on VINCI Energiesin energia-alan ratkaisuihin erikoistunut brändi.

title: Product Designer (UX/UI & Research)
description:
Job Description

The Product Designer (UI/UX & Research) at LGC is responsible for leading user research and crafting flawless end-to-end experiences that optimize user-centered digital journeys. We are interested in someone who can focus on improving website performance and conversion through data-driven UX and CRO protocols.

We are looking for someone to ensure alignment with industry and digital guideline customer experience standards. By translating customer behavior into high-impact, intuitive design solutions, you will drive meaningful improvements in engagement across our digital ecosystem!

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead comprehensive UX research efforts, including interviews, surveys, behavioral analysis, prototype testing, and usability studies, to identify user needs, confirm concepts, and produce actionable insights.
  • Translate research insights, data, and business requirements into user journeys, wireframes, and prototypes, ensuring experiences are accessible, user-centered, and aligned with CX guidelines.
  • Own the development and evolution of UI/UX deliverables, producing low and high-fidelity builds, interaction patterns, and design system components within Figma.
  • Analyze website and product performance using GA, Hotjar, session recordings, VOC insights, and heatmaps to identify friction points and drive iterative optimization.
  • Collaborate with web product management, developers, SMEs, and cross-functional teams to build scope, ensure technical feasibility, and deliver implementation-ready specifications.
  • Facilitate workshops, compose reviews, and working sessions to build shared understanding, present design decisions clearly, and influence strategic, experience-led discussions.
  • Champion user-first thinking, contribute to experimentation and optimization efforts, and support the development and management of the organization’s design system and new technologies. This helps to proactively find ways to improve and grow.

Skills You'll Use Every Day

  • Proven expertise across UX research and UX building, including usability testing, behavioral analysis, CRO-aligned optimization, and the ability to translate insights into high-quality digital experiences.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, adept at interpreting qualitative and quantitative data (e.g., Hotjar, GA, heatmaps) to guide iterative build improvements.
  • Advanced proficiency with Figma, covering design systems, components, and variants, with a refined eye for UI craft, interaction development, and accessibility guidelines.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and partner management skills, capable of influencing cross-functional teams and guiding collaborative decision-making.
  • Ability to own end-to-end build delivery, from discovery research and journeys to high-fidelity prototypes and detailed specifications aligned with engineering partners.
  • Familiarity with experimentation and analytics platforms (e.g., Optimizely, GA), with sufficient front-end awareness to collaborate effectively with developers and ensure composed intent is preserved through build.
  • Highly organized and adaptable, able to balance critical thinking with hands-on delivery, while contributing to the evolution of the build system and broader design culture.

title: Digital Twin Scientist
description:
Job Description

About us

Fusion, the process that powers the sun and stars, is one of the most promising options for generating the cleaner, carbon-free energy that our world badly needs. UKAEA leads the way in realizing fusion energy, partnering with industry and research organisations to achieve ground-breaking advancements. Our goal is to bring fusion electricity to the grid by developing the power stations of tomorrow and the skilled workforce to deliver them.

About the Job

The UK Atomic Energy Authority (UKAEA) Computing Division is at the forefront of advanced computing, delivering research, development, and specialist support to enable world-leading fusion energy research. Our expertise spans cloud computing, high performance and high throughput computing, scientific software, artificial intelligence, machine learning, exascale technologies, and data visualisation. Working alongside leading scientists, engineers, academia, and industry partners, we develop innovative computing solutions that accelerate scientific discovery and shape the future of advanced computing infrastructure in the UK and beyond.

You will provide technical leadership and mentorship while delivering innovative Digital Twin solutions that support cutting-edge scientific and engineering programmes. You'll lead projects and multidisciplinary teams, contribute to software development and technical strategy, and act as a recognised subject matter expert within UKAEA. With a high degree of autonomy, you'll collaborate across the organisation and represent UKAEA at national and international events, helping to drive the adoption and impact of Digital Twin Technologies and advanced data visualisation techniques.

We're looking for someone with:

  • Knowledge of visualisation frameworks (Kitware-Paraview, Omniverse, Blender, Unity, Unreal-Engine)

  • Track record of publications in Digital Twin and/or Advanced Visualisation

  • Experience in Data governance, data integration, data engineering

  • Skills in visualisation-relevant data formats (VTK, VTU, USD, OpenUSD, HDF5)

  • Experience with CAD-relevant data formats (STEP, JT, STL)

  • Knowledge of Digital twin software (Omniverse, Ansys-Twin-Builder, Siemens-NX)

  • Experience with HPC and GPU architectures for graphics technologies (Nvidia RTX)

  • Knowledge of Digital Threads technologies (Galaxy, Apache-Airflow)

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Lead Digital Twin projects, ensuring milestones are delivered on time, within budget, and to a high standard.

  • Manage and mentor a small team of 4–6 specialists.

  • Collaborate with leading academic, research, and industry partners to develop next-generation Digital Twin capabilities and evaluate emerging computing technologies.

  • Drive the development of innovative visualisation tools, frameworks, and workflows for scientific data, real-time analysis, AI-driven visual analytics, and high-performance computing environments.

  • Develop strategic Digital Twin capabilities across UKAEA, securing research funding, influencing organisational standards, and promoting best practice through cross-functional collaboration.

What you'll Bring:

  • A PhD degree in a computational, mathematical or physical science discipline, with demonstratable Post-Doctoral experience (or equivalent experience in either a commercial or research environment), relevant to the area of Digital Twin for fusion science, such as Advanced Visualisation, Digital Engineering, Data Science, Modelling.

  • Recognised internationally as an expert in the field of Digital Twins for fusion.

  • Demonstrable experience managing projects, budget and resource allocation.

  • Track record of publishing research in the area of Digital Twins for fusion, or a similar area of research with transferable knowledge to fusion science.

  • Demonstrable experience of at least one compiled programming language (e.g. C++, Fortran, C, Rust) or advanced scripting language (e.g. Python Julia, R)

  • Good experience of the UNIX operating system, particularly the command line interface

  • Ability to work within a diverse team, but willingness to take significant personal responsibility

  • Excellent written and spoken English

UKAEA is an onsite organisation, and this role requires regular onsite presence (usually between 3-5 days in any given week) in line with business needs. We actively support flexible working arrangements where this is compatible with the role.

Benefits

We have a generous range of benefits (see the full list here) and highlights include:

  • A salary of £64,820 (inclusive of a £6,500 specialist allowance)

  • Up to 7% corporate performance bonus

  • Final salary defined benefits pension scheme with an equivalent of 21.5% employer pension contribution

  • 25 days annual leave, 2.5 privilege days and 8 Bank Holidays

  • 3 days of site closure over Christmas break

  • Flexible working options plus family-friendly leave provisions

Our commitment to ED&I

UKAEA's mission is clean energy for all, and we welcome talented people from all backgrounds to help us achieve this goal. We are committed to equality, diversity, inclusion and accessibility, and strive to ensure fair representation across our workforce.

Please email talent@ukaea.uk if you have any questions or require adjustments to help you participate fairly in our recruitment process, for example changes to the way we interview or share information. As a Disability Confident Employer, we are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience for all candidates.

We particularly encourage applications from groups currently underrepresented in STEM, including women and people from diverse ethnic backgrounds. All appointments are made on merit and further information can be found here.

description:
The Applied Research Laboratory (ARL) at Penn State is seeking an experienced Sustainment Systems Research and Development Engineer to join our Sustainment Information Systems Department. ARL’s mission is to deliver innovative engineering and technology solutions in support of the Department of Defense (DoD).

In this role, you will leverage your expertise in DevOps, enterprise architectures, digital transformation, and sustainment system software engineering to support applied research in defense applications, with an emphasis on NAVSEA environments and submarine platform support.

ARL is an authorized DoD SkillBridge partner and welcomes applications from transitioning military members.

You Will:

  • Lead and support the design, development, and deployment of advanced sustainment information systems for defense applications

  • Define enterprise information system architectures and implement digital transformation best practices to optimize defense sustainment processes

  • Prototype and demonstrate enterprise systems architectures leveraging modern cloud-native and DevOps approaches (Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD pipelines)

  • Apply expertise in cloud, container orchestration, and software lifecycle automation to enterprise sustainment challenges

  • Investigate and implement emerging technologies to enhance logistics, training, and sustainment systems

  • Deliver professional reports and executive-level presentations documenting findings and recommendations

  • Contribute to technical proposals, risk assessments, and cost/effort estimates for research initiatives

  • Collaborate with government and industry sponsors as well as Penn State faculty on applied research projects

  • Mentor junior engineers in software engineering, DevOps practices, and project execution

Additional responsibilities for higher level position includes:

  • Lead and mentor a team of engineers in the development and implementation of software systems

  • Engage with the sponsor and external collaborators to coordinate the development of complex software systems

Required skills/experience areas include:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering or related discipline;
    advanced degree preferred

  • 7+ years of professional experience in software engineering, DevOps, and enterprise systems development

  • Experience deploying solutions in NAVSEA cloud environments

  • Experience working with and modernizing current sustainment information systems used by Trident Refit Facilities

  • Proven ability to collaborate with DoD stakeholders to define requirements, evaluate solution paths, and deliver technical capabilities

  • Demonstrated success driving digital transformation initiatives using cloud-native architectures and CI/CD automation

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, GitLab CI/CD, Helm, and supporting enterprise sustainment platforms

  • Background in developing sustainment software solutions for defense applications.

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work independently or in multidisciplinary teams

Preferred skills/experience areas include:

  • Certifications in Kubernetes, Azure, Scrum, and Security+ (as held by strong candidates)

  • Published research or technical documentation in enterprise sustainment or digital engineering

This position will be fully on-stie located in State College, PA. Questions related to flexible work should be directed to the hiring manager during the interview process. This position will require periodic travel to remote locations in support of testing as part of a small team of researchers, engineers, and technologists.

title: Process Validation Specialist - Torrance
description:
Process Validation Specialist
Location: Torrance, CA | Employment Type: Full-Time

Support compliant, reliable manufacturing for clinical and commercial products.

At PolyPeptide, we partner with pharmaceutical and biotech companies to support the development and manufacturing of peptide based therapies. We are looking for a Process Validation Specialist to help ensure our manufacturing processes are compliant, reproducible, and ready to support high quality clinical and commercial production.

This role is a great fit for someone who enjoys technical documentation, data review, validation execution, and working with cross functional teams in a fast paced cGMP environment.

About the Role

The Process Validation Specialist supports process validation activities through protocol preparation, execution support, data review, and documentation. This role works closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, and R&D to support process validation, equipment qualification, cleaning validation, and continued process verification activities.

You will play an important role in helping ensure manufacturing processes meet regulatory expectations, internal quality standards, and customer delivery commitments.

What You Will Do

  • Execute and maintain process validation protocols, reports, and documentation, including IQ, OQ, and PQ activities.

  • Support cleaning validation, equipment qualification, and continued process verification programs.

  • Assist with planning and coordinating validation activities for new processes, technology transfers, and scale ups.

  • Review and analyze process data to help identify critical process parameters and support process robustness.

  • Collaborate with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, and R&D to define validation requirements and resolve deviations.

  • Participate in root cause investigations and support CAPA implementation related to process deviations.

  • Support internal audits, external audits, and regulatory inspections by providing validation documentation and subject matter support.

  • Assist with validation lifecycle activities, including periodic requalification and risk assessments.

  • Maintain compliance with cGMP requirements, FDA, EMA, ICH Q8 through Q10, and applicable industry best practices.

What We Are Looking For

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Chemistry, or a related technical discipline.

  • 1 to 3 years of experience in cGMP manufacturing, quality, or research and development.

  • Previous experience in process validation or validation engineering within pharmaceutical, biotech, or CDMO environments is preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Working knowledge of cGMP regulations, ICH guidelines, and validation lifecycle principles.

  • Experience with protocol generation, execution, documentation, and deviation or CAPA support.

  • Familiarity with process development, manufacturing operations, and data analysis.

  • Experience with statistical analysis tools such as Minitab is a plus.

Skills and Competencies

  • Strong technical writing, analytical, and organizational skills.

  • High attention to detail and a quality focused mindset.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

  • Effective communication and collaboration across technical, quality, and manufacturing teams.

  • Strong problem solving skills and ability to support risk based validation decisions.

  • Commitment to compliance, inspection readiness, and continuous improvement.

Why Join PolyPeptide?

At PolyPeptide, your work supports the manufacturing of peptide based therapies that can make a meaningful impact for patients. In this role, you will help strengthen validation practices, support process reliability, and contribute to successful manufacturing outcomes for clinical and commercial programs.

If you are looking to grow your validation experience in a technical, quality focused, and collaborative environment, we encourage you to apply.

Work Environment

This role may involve work in an office, laboratory, or GMP manufacturing environment. Depending on project needs, work may require gowning and PPE in controlled areas.

Physical requirements may include prolonged sitting or standing, movement between work areas, occasional lifting of up to 25 pounds, repetitive tasks, and potential exposure to chemicals, equipment noise, or temperature controlled environments. Occasional evening, weekend, or overtime hours may be required to support production or testing deadlines.

Reasonable accommodations will be made as needed.

Apply Today

Join PolyPeptide and help support compliant, high quality manufacturing for the future of peptide based therapies.

Salary: $80k-$100k

Som montagekoordinator bliver du en central spiller i vores projekter og arbejder tæt sammen med både byggelederne, salgsteamet og montørerne for at sikre høj kvalitet og levering af så mange fejlfrie huse som muligt.

title: Process Development Scientist - San Diego
description:
Process Development Scientist

Location: San Diego, CA | Employment Type: Full-Time

Help bring complex peptide processes from the lab to manufacturing.

PolyPeptide is seeking a Process Development Scientist to support the design, execution, optimization, and scale-up of synthetic processes for peptide API development. This role is a strong fit for a scientist who enjoys hands-on process development, technical problem-solving, and working closely with cross-functional teams to move projects from development into scalable, cGMP-compliant manufacturing.

As a Process Development Scientist, you will play an important role in developing robust, efficient, and cost-effective processes that support clinical and commercial manufacturing. Your work will directly contribute to PolyPeptide’s commitment to quality, technical excellence, and on-time delivery for our customers.

Why this role matters

The transition from laboratory development to manufacturing is a critical step in delivering high-quality APIs to customers. In this role, you will help bridge that gap by applying your expertise in organic chemistry, peptide chemistry, purification, process development, and technology transfer.

You will have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects, solve complex technical challenges, and support processes that are essential to pharmaceutical development and manufacturing.

What you will do

  • Plan and coordinate technology transfer activities from Development to Production, both onsite and across sites

  • Design, execute, and optimize synthetic processes for peptide API development

  • Perform intermediate chemical processing steps using established safety and process procedures

  • Check reactor systems for proper operation in accordance with SOPs and operating manuals

  • Monitor chemical reactions during processing and respond appropriately to ensure proper execution

  • Prepare solutions for purification

  • Interpret test results and take appropriate action to support acceptable processing

  • Purify crude peptide using HPLC under minimal supervision

  • Conduct lyophilization and drying processes according to established procedures

  • Perform in-process checks of fractions using analytical HPLC and report results to supervision or senior development personnel

  • Support troubleshooting of equipment and processing issues

  • Identify and report deviations, equipment concerns, or unresolved processing issues

  • Maintain high standards for safety, housekeeping, and cleanliness

  • Support cross-functional project teams with technical expertise

  • Perform additional duties aligned with the needs of the role and organization

What you bring

  • Ph.D. in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline with at least 1 year of relevant experience, or Master’s degree with at least 5 years of relevant experience

  • Industry experience with a focus on organic chemistry

  • Strong knowledge of synthetic organic chemistry, process development, and analytical techniques

  • Experience with peptide chemistry and downstream purification preferred

  • Ability to interpret analytical results and apply sound scientific judgment

  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills

  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating with multidisciplinary teams

  • Strong communication skills and attention to detail

Preferred experience

  • Experience with peptide chemistry, or API development

  • Experience with HPLC purification, analytical HPLC, lyophilization, and drying processes

  • Experience with scale-up and technology transfer into manufacturing environments

  • Familiarity with cGMP requirements and regulatory expectations for clinical or commercial manufacturing

  • Experience working in a CDMO, pharmaceutical, biotech, or regulated manufacturing environment

What makes you successful in this role

You are hands-on, scientifically curious, and comfortable working in a technical development environment. You know how to approach complex chemistry challenges with structure and attention to detail, while keeping safety, quality, and scalability in mind.

You are able to work independently, communicate clearly with technical and cross-functional partners, and contribute to successful technology transfer from development into manufacturing.

Why join PolyPeptide

At PolyPeptide, you will be part of a quality-driven organization supporting the development and manufacturing of peptide-based and other complex pharmaceutical programs. You will work with experienced scientists, production teams, and cross-functional partners to help deliver high-quality solutions for customers.

This is an opportunity to apply your chemistry expertise in a role where your work has a direct impact on process development, manufacturing readiness, and customer success.

If you are looking for a role where you can solve technical challenges, support meaningful pharmaceutical programs, and help bring complex processes from the lab to production, we encourage you to apply.

Salary: $90K - $115K

title: Principal Solution Architect
description:
Envitia is a UK-based software and services company that helps organisations unlock the full value of their data to make better, faster decisions. With over 30 years of experience, we specialise in delivering innovative software products, solutions, and consultancy services that transform complex data challenges into actionable insights.

Our mission is to empower customers across defence, government, and national security sectors to harness the power of data — from geospatial intelligence to advanced analytics and AI integration. We are proud to be a trusted partner to UK defence and government organisations, delivering technology that drives smarter, data-driven outcomes.

We’re also delighted to have been named one of The Sunday Times Top 100 Medium-Sized Companies — a recognition of our commitment to innovation, collaboration, and creating an outstanding workplace where people can thrive.

The Role


As a Principal Solution Architect, you will lead the design and delivery of complex digital and data transformation solutions for Defence, Central Government and wider public sector organisations. Working at the forefront of some of the UK's most critical and challenging programmes, you will shape solution strategy, define target architectures, influence senior stakeholders and provide technical leadership across multi-disciplinary teams.


As part of Envitia's Consulting division, you will play a key role in growing and evolving our architecture capability. You will help develop reusable frameworks, reference architectures and best practices that accelerate delivery and strengthen our market-leading solutions.


You will work closely with customers to understand their objectives, translate complex requirements into practical and achievable solutions, and provide architectural assurance throughout the delivery lifecycle. You will also support business growth through pre-sales activities, leading solution development, shaping technical approaches, producing cost and effort estimates, and contributing to compelling client proposals.


Beyond project delivery, you will represent Envitia within the wider market, attending industry events, engaging with customer communities, and showcasing our expertise, products and innovation across data, geospatial and digital transformation domains.

Responsibilities


  • Lead the design, governance and assurance of complex solution architectures across Defence, Central Government and public sector transformation programmes.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to clients, providing strategic direction and ensuring solutions deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Define solution strategies and target architectures that balance business objectives, technical excellence, security requirements and commercial considerations.
  • Provide architectural leadership across large, multi-disciplinary teams, supporting the successful delivery of complex digital, data and technology solutions.
  • Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders, influencing technology roadmaps, transformation strategies and investment decisions.
  • Lead architecture governance activities, including design reviews, assurance processes and technical decision-making forums.
  • Support business growth through pre-sales activities, including opportunity shaping, solution development, bid responses, estimates and client presentations.
  • Develop and maintain architectural frameworks, standards, reference architectures and best practices that support consistent, high-quality delivery.
  • Drive innovation by creating reusable assets, accelerators and go-to-market offerings that enhance client value and strengthen Envitia's market position.
  • Identify emerging technologies and industry trends, applying them to solve client challenges and inform future service offerings.
  • Contribute to the development of business cases, risk assessments, delivery strategies and commercial proposals for complex opportunities.
  • Mentor and support architects, consultants and delivery teams, helping to grow Envitia's architecture capability and community of practice.

Experience Required


Essential Experience


  • Experience operating as a Solution Architect, Enterprise Architect or Principal Architect within Defence, National Security, Central Government or similarly complex environments.
  • Proven ability to define architecture strategies and translate business, operational and technical requirements into scalable, practical solutions.
  • Experience leading large-scale digital and data transformation programmes from strategy through to delivery.
  • Strong consulting and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior client, technical and executive audiences.
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor, helping clients shape technology roadmaps, target architectures and transformation strategies.
  • A successful track record supporting business development activities, including pre-sales engagements, solution design, bid responses and client presentations.


Technical Expertise


  • Strong knowledge of enterprise architecture approaches, frameworks and modelling techniques such as TOGAF, ArchiMate or Zachman.
  • Broad technical knowledge spanning cloud transformation, enterprise integration, legacy modernisation and large-scale distributed systems.
  • Understanding of security, governance, data management and assurance requirements within regulated or secure environments.

Security Clearance Requirements

Due to the nature of our work, the successful candidate must be eligible to obtain and maintain SC security clearance.

Location

This role offers flexible and remote working, with travel to our Horsham office approximately two days per month and occasional travel to customer sites across the UK as required.

What it's like to work at Envitia

At Envitia, we believe that our greatest asset is our people. We’re committed to fostering a work environment where every employee feels valued, supported, and motivated to excel. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to enhance both your professional and personal wellbeing, including:

  • Annual Leave: 25 days plus your birthday off, with the ability to buy or sell up to five additional days
  • Private Healthcare: Comprehensive coverage with additional options for family members
  • Training & Skills Development: Ongoing learning opportunities to help you advance your career
  • Fitness Reimbursement: Support for gym memberships or fitness-related expenses
  • Life Assurance: Extensive life insurance coverage for peace of mind
  • Pension Contribution: Competitive options to help you plan for a secure financial future
  • Perkbox Subscription: Discounts on a wide range of products and services
  • Flexible Work Arrangements: Designed to support work-life balance and personal commitments
  • Internal Reward Schemes: Recognition initiatives to celebrate your contributions and achievements
  • Community Engagement & Volunteering: Opportunities to support meaningful causes through company-sponsored programs

Inclusion at Envitia

At Envitia, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life. We believe that our strength lies in our differences, and we are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered.

We encourage applications from people of all abilities, ages, genders, sexual orientations, races, ethnicities, and religions. We strive to support a culture of inclusion, accessibility, and work-life balance.

If you require any accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know.

title: EPC Tender Specialist
description:
SUMMARY OF ROLE

The resource will be assigned within the technical-commercial department and will support tendering and proposal activities for electrical substations, including MV/HV equipment, auxiliary systems, civil interfaces and related balance of plant.

The candidate will be responsible for analysing customer RFQs, technical specifications and drawings, preparing technical clarifications, defining the estimating scope and developing accurate and competitive cost evaluations for substation projects.

At least 3 years' experience in technical tendering, cost estimation, proposal engineering or engineering support for electrical substations, power infrastructure or similar EPC projects is preferred.

Strong commitment to transversal activities is mandatory, including the coordination of tender task forces and the ability to guide Engineering, R&D, Procurement, Sales, Supply Chain and external partners on the actions required to develop a complete and consistent substation proposal.

The candidate will collect and evaluate suppliers' and subcontractors' quotations, including civil works and installation-related scopes, perform technical-commercial alignment and identify cost optimization opportunities while ensuring that any technical change or additional item is correctly assessed in terms of cost, schedule, civil interfaces, electrical interfaces and overall project impact.

PRINCIPAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACTIVITIES

The candidate will:

  • Receive and review Customer RFQs, tender documents, technical specifications, drawings, schedules and scope of work for substation projects

  • Identify Customer needs, technical requirements, contractual constraints and missing information requiring clarification

  • Coordinate dedicated tender task forces for substation opportunities, assigning actions, setting priorities, monitoring progress and ensuring alignment among all involved functions

  • Provide clear technical and commercial instructions to Engineering and R&D teams on how to proceed during tender development, including required analyses, design inputs, technical clarifications and cost assumptions

  • Analyse single line diagrams, layouts, equipment lists, protection and control requirements, auxiliary systems and civil interfaces relevant to the estimating scope

  • Define the technical solution and estimate basis, including assumptions, exclusions, scope split and interfaces with customer, civil works, installation and commissioning activities

  • Prepare material take-offs and cost estimates for main substation equipment, including transformers, switchgear, circuit breakers, disconnectors, instrument transformers, protection panels, control systems, auxiliary transformers, cables, earthing, steel structures and related accessories

  • Estimate engineering, project management, procurement, testing, supervision, commissioning and other project-related workloads

  • Request, compare and technically align supplier and subcontractor quotations in coordination with Supply Chain and Engineering

  • Interface with suppliers and subcontractors, including civil works providers, to clarify scope, interfaces, technical requirements, quantities, construction constraints and cost impacts

  • Prepare cost breakdowns, bid summaries, technical clarifications, deviations, exclusions and supporting documentation for tender approval

  • Identify technical and commercial risks, cost drivers, schedule impacts and value engineering opportunities

  • Assess the impact of scope changes or additional items by understanding how one modification may affect civil works, electrical works, layout, equipment sizing, installation, testing, commissioning, schedule and total project cost

  • Support internal bid reviews and handover activities to project execution teams after award

  • Participate in customer meetings, pre-bid clarifications and technical-commercial discussions when required

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

Education and Qualifications

  • University Degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering or equivalent technical experience in substation or power infrastructure projects

  • MS Office, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

  • SAP, AutoCAD, MS Project/Primavera, estimating tools and power system analysis software are preferential qualifications

Experience & Knowledge

  • Technical background in MV/HV substations, power systems, electrical infrastructure or EPC tendering

title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer (Firmware)
description:
Senior Embedded Software Engineer

Cambridge, UK | Full-time | Permanent | Hybrid

Salary: £70,000 to £90,000 DOE

The salary range for this role is broad, as we are able to consider varying levels of experience. Any offer made will carefully take into account level of experience (including relevant industry experience), transferable relevant skills and previous relevant achievements.

Please indicate your preferred working schedule in your cover letter.

About us

Riverlane’s mission is to master quantum error correction (QEC) and unlock a new age of human progress. From advances in material and climate science, to complex chemistry simulation for new drug design, quantum computers will help humanity solve some of its most important challenges. But without QEC, the industry’s defining technical challenge, such breakthroughs can never be achieved. Riverlane is the world leader in QEC technology. QEC is a complex problem that requires a range of skills, talent and passion.

Having raised more than $125M in funding to date to accelerate our cutting-edge R&D in quantum error correction (QEC), Riverlane partners with many of the world’s leading quantum hardware providers and government agencies to make fault-tolerant quantum computing a reality. We’re making remarkable progress and growing fast.

About the role

At Riverlane, we build new and advanced solutions to solve one of the hardest problems in quantum computing: quantum error correction (QEC). As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer at Riverlane, you will help build the world’s first quantum error correction stack - Deltaflow. This cutting-edge work will involve collaborating with our world-class engineering, product and quantum physics teams to design, build and deliver this stack.

At Riverlane, we are creating something truly unique, complex and large-scale, so being comfortable with engineering to evolving specs is key. As such, you will be happy and excited to get hands-on quickly in areas outside your own expertise. You will also work well with different people and be team-oriented.

Prior quantum computing knowledge is not necessary - you will learn this along the way!

What you will do:

  • Design and build embedded software components for our quantum error correction stack, specifically targeting features that aid with seamless deployment of our product to partners
  • Integrate our QEC stack into world-class quantum computing systems
  • Develop test infrastructure to verify and benchmark whole-system correctness and performance
  • Work alongside our Product and Quantum Science teams to understand the requirements and constraints for this cutting-edge system

What we need

  • A Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, Physics, Maths or a related discipline
  • Great communication skills and an ability to work with a diverse range of people are essential
  • Strong C++ skills
  • Proficiency with a scripting language, such as Python
  • Curiosity to learn about new technologies, including quantum computing and error correction
  • A deep understanding of how hardware implements software
  • Experience with standard development practises, such as source control, continuous integration and unit testing

Even better if you have…

  • Hands-on experience of working alongside hardware design
  • Experience writing embedded software in high-performance applications

What can you expect from us

  • A comprehensive benefits package that includes an annual bonus plan, private medical insurance, life insurance, and a contributory pension scheme
  • Equity, so that our team can share in the long-term success of Riverlane
  • 28 days annual leave, plus bank holidays and enhanced family leave
  • A diverse work environment that brings together experts in many fields (including software and hardware development, quantum information theory, physics and maths) and over 20 different nationalities
  • A learning environment that encourages individual, team and company growth and development, including a regular programme of learning events and training and conference budgets

How to apply

Please upload a CV and covering letter by clicking 'Apply'. Your covering letter should explain why you are applying for the job and what skills and experience you can bring to the role.

We review CVs as we receive them and interview as soon as we have applications that look like a good match. We do not use closing dates. So, please apply as soon as possible to avoid missing out on this role.

If you have any queries, please contact jobs@riverlane.com.

Everyone is welcome at Riverlane. We are an equal opportunities employer and encourage applications from eligible and suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, ethnicity, gender, gender reassignment, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, or pregnancy and maternity/paternity.

Women and other underrepresented groups may be less likely to apply for a role unless they meet all or nearly all of the requirements. If this applies to you, we still encourage you to apply - you may be a great fit, even if you don’t meet every single qualification. We’d love to hear from you.

If you need any adjustments made to the application or selection process so you can do your best, please let us know. We will be happy to help.

description:
Product Manager – Sell-Side D2C (Dealer to Client) Fixed Income Trading Location London Business Area Product Ref # 10052690

Description & Requirements

Bloomberg's Trade Execution Management System (TEMS) is a market-leading, end-to-end fixed income sell-side trading platform used by leading market making institutions worldwide. As fixed income markets continue to evolve toward electronic execution, our clients rely on TEMS to manage increasingly sophisticated D2C (Dealer-to-Client) trading workflows across multiple asset classes, venues, and trading protocols.

Our D2C platform provides mission critical trading through venue connectivity, RFQ workflow management, trading rule engines, and intuitive user interfaces. It enables dealers to efficiently price, negotiate, execute, and manage client trades while seamlessly integrating with Bloomberg and third-party trading ecosystems, including TOMS OMS.

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Product Manager to join our team to define and drive the strategy for Bloomberg's Sell-Side D2C fixed income trading platform.

This is a highly visible role with significant ownership. You will shape the future of Bloomberg's D2C trading capabilities while ensuring our existing client base continues to receive best-in-class solutions. Working closely with Engineering, Sales, Professional Services, Clients, and other TEMS product teams, you will translate market needs into innovative products that help dealers better serve their customers.

Success in this role requires a deep understanding of fixed income electronic trading, strong product management skills, and the ability to balance long-term product vision with day-to-day delivery.

We Will Trust You to

  • Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for Bloomberg's Sell-Side TEMS D2C trading platform.
  • Partner with Engineering to scope, prioritize, and deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Collaborate with other TEMS Product Managers to deliver seamless end-to-end trading workflows.
  • Gather client feedback and market intelligence to identify opportunities and influence product direction.
  • Translate business requirements into clear functional specifications, including workflow design and service level expectations.
  • Drive product delivery from concept through release, balancing client needs, engineering effort, and strategic priorities.
  • Present product strategy, business cases, and development progress to senior management.
  • Represent Bloomberg with clients, prospects, venue partners, and industry participants.
  • Work closely with Sales, Professional Services, and Client Support teams to ensure successful product adoption and client outcomes.

You Will Need to Have

  • 5+ years of experience in Fixed Income Dealer-to-Client (D2C) electronic trading.*
  • 2+ years of Product Management experience
  • Strong knowledge of one or more fixed income asset classes, including Rates, Credit, Muni, or Derivatives.
  • Experience defining and delivering software products throughout the full software development lifecycle.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively across Product, Engineering, Sales, and client-facing teams.

We Would Love to See

  • Experience with fixed income electronic trading platforms, execution management systems (EMS), or order management systems (OMS).
  • Deep understanding of the RFQ lifecycle and major electronic trading venue protocols and specifications.
  • Knowledge of market structure, electronic trading workflows, and regulatory requirements affecting fixed income markets.
  • Technical understanding of low-latency or high-performance distributed systems.
  • Experience working directly with trading desks, dealers, or institutional fixed income clients.


If indicated, please note that years of experience are a guide; we will consider applications from all candidates who can demonstrate the skills necessary for the role.
