title: DATA ENGINEER T0 ELLOS GROUP
description:
Do you want to help build the next-generation data platform at one of the Nordic region’s leading e-commerce companies?

Ellos Group is in the middle of a major data and platform transformation and is now looking for a Senior Data Engineer who wants to play a key role in the transition from a traditional on-premises data warehouse to a modern, cloud-based data platform built on Azure and Microsoft Fabric.

We look forward to receiving your application!

YOUR ROLE

As a Data Engineer, you will become a key member of the Data & Analytics team within Ellos IT. You will work closely with our Senior BI Developer, who also serves as Product Owner for BI, and together you will drive the technical direction of the data platform. This is a hands-on role with significant influence over architecture, technology choices and ways of working.

You will work at the intersection of traditional data warehousing and modern event-driven architectures, where microservices, Kafka and streaming data come together with established data models and business logic. You will collaborate closely with the business, BI, Data Science and other development teams, building solutions that support business-critical operations.

In this role, you will:

  • Build, further develop and optimise Ellos Group’s new data platform in Azure and Microsoft Fabric, with a strong focus on performance tuning, cost efficiency and operational stability.

  • Design and develop data pipelines for both real-time and batch processing, working with data sources such as Kafka, internal microservices, Microsoft SQL Server and Google Analytics.

  • Drive the migration from an established on-premises data warehouse to a modern cloud-based platform, ensuring that existing functionality is recreated, improved and future-proofed.

  • Work closely with BI developers, Data Scientists and Product Owners to ensure high data quality, well-defined business concepts and data models that support both analytics and business-critical processes.

Your day will often begin with a team stand-up, followed by development work, technical discussions, backlog refinement or workshops. We work in an agile and collaborative way, whether you are working from the office or remotely.

WHO YOU ARE

You are a highly experienced Data Engineer with strong technical confidence and a broad understanding of modern data platforms. You enjoy taking responsibility, making architectural and technical decisions and remaining hands-on in designing, building, optimising and maintaining production solutions. You have extensive experience of cloud-based data platforms and are comfortable working in complex environments with large data volumes, demanding performance requirements and business-critical workloads.

You have a solid understanding of dimensional modelling, traditional data warehousing and Kimball principles, together with a strong focus on data quality, consistency and structure. Working with streaming and real-time data comes naturally to you, and you have a good understanding of Kafka-based architectures, event-driven systems and microservices, including the challenges of scalability and cost-efficient cloud operations.

You have a clear view of how a modern lakehouse architecture should be designed, maintained and developed over time. You have worked hands-on with a range of platforms and technologies, both open source and commercial, in on-premises and cloud environments, giving you a solid understanding of their respective strengths and limitations. Your background may include technologies such as Databricks and Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Hadoop/Hortonworks, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Azure Synapse Analytics, Cloudera or AWS Lakehouse, and you use that experience to make well-informed architectural and technology decisions.

As a person, you are self-driven, analytical and collaborative. You enjoy sharing your knowledge and acting as a technical sounding board for both colleagues and business stakeholders. You are curious, solution-oriented and motivated by building sustainable, long-term data solutions that create real value for the business.

To succeed in this role, you need to be fluent in both spoken and written Swedish. You hold a university degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or have equivalent professional experience.

WANT TO KNOW MORE?

In this recruitment, Ellos Group is working together with Nexer Recruit. If you would like to know more, please contact: Johanna Värmfors johanna.varmfors@nexergroup.com alt. +46 73 082 12 30 or Patrik Jensen, Patrik.jensen@nexergroup.com alt. +46 70 237 57 34

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

ABOUT ELLOS GROUP

Ellos Group is one of the Nordic region’s leading online destinations for home furnishings and fashion, with the e-commerce brands Ellos, Jotex and Homeroom, as well as the payment brand Elpy. Through close relationships with millions of customers, we develop attractive and sustainable offerings for women in the middle of life, their families and their homes. Innovation, creativity and sustainability are at the heart of everything we do, and we are constantly looking for new ways to improve while always keeping the customer in focus.

Headquartered in Borås, Sweden, Ellos Group operates across the Nordic countries and selected European markets. The company has approximately 500 employees and annual revenue of around SEK 3.3 billion.

title: Program Coordinator
description:
Who We Are

At ERC Pathlight, we’re on a mission to change lives—and we’re looking for people who feel called to do the same.

As one of the nation’s leading treatment providers for eating disorders and mood, anxiety, and trauma-related conditions, we bring innovative, evidence-based, and deeply compassionate care to patients across the country. With multiple locations nationwide and extensive virtual programming, we meet patients exactly where they are and help them move toward lasting recovery.

Founded in 2008 by renowned psychiatrists and psychologists, ERC Pathlight now supports more than 6,000 patients each year. And as the need for world-class mental health care continues to rise, our commitment is stronger than ever: to expand access, elevate the standard of care, and empower every patient to rebuild their life with dignity and hope.

Why Join Us

When you join ERC Pathlight, you become part of a team that shows up every day to make a real difference. You’ll work alongside passionate clinicians, dedicated support staff, and mission-driven leaders who believe in collaboration, growth, and doing the right thing—always.

Here, your work matters. Your ideas matter. You matter.

If you’re energized by purpose, motivated by impact, and ready to help transform the future of mental health treatment, you belong here.

Come build hope. Come save lives. Come grow with us.

What you’ll be doing:

Schedule: PRN shift 6:30am to 7pm

The Program Coordinator (PC I, PC II, PC III) is responsible for providing direct care and supervision to patients within inpatient, residential, and partial hospitalization levels of care at ERC Pathlight. Program Coordinators maintain a safe, structured, and therapeutic milieu while supporting the implementation of individualized treatment plans.

PCs provide patient supervision, maintain structure and boundaries, support therapeutic programming, assist with mealtime support, and complete required documentation. Level placement (I, II, III) is determined based on education, experience, and demonstrated competency.

Essential duties and responsibilities:

  • Milieu Management
  • Maintain daily program structure by following the established schedule
  • Complete observation rounds and safety checks as ordered by physician
  • Support patients with de-escalation and implementation of coping skills per treatment plan
  • Conduct room and luggage searches
  • Supervise fresh air breaks and mindful movement exposures
  • Provide ongoing bathroom monitoring
  • Obtain and document patient vital signs, weights, and urine specific gravity (as applicable by location/program)
  • Group Facilitation
  • Participate in facilitation of therapeutic groups
  • Complete required EHR documentation related to group facilitation
  • Support group-based social activities and meal outings
  • Meal Support
  • Participate in all meals and snacks with patients
  • Provide meal support using coaching and skills aligned with the treatment team
  • Complete timely and accurate meal-related documentation
  • Support dietitians in preparation for Nutrition and Cooking Groups
  • Ensure adherence to individualized meal plans and allergy-safety protocols
  • Support restaurant outings as needed
  • Administrative & Operational Support
  • Complete required documentation in compliance with organizational and regulatory standards, including patient observations, meals, and shift-related events
  • Provide patient transportation for medical appointments (as applicable by location/program)
  • Support additional transportation needs including outings, grocery procurement, or other facility needs
  • Assist with food procurement as needed (may occur weekly)
  • Distribute mail and packages daily

Position Expectations (All Levels)

  • All Program Coordinators must:
  • Be willing and able to work at all ERC Pathlight local sites as assigned
  • Be compliant with certification and regulatory requirements for each practice location
  • Maintain a flexible schedule to meet organizational staffing needs
  • Be available to work weekends and holidays as required
  • Be available to work on-call shifts based on business needs and in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local labor laws

Must haves:

Program Coordinator I (PC I)

  • High School Diploma or GED (Required)
  • Entry-level role: no prior direct patient care experience required unless required by state regulation (Required)
  • Valid driver’s license with safe driving record: required only at locations operating company vehicles or requiring driving on behalf of the company (Required)
  • Washington teammates must hold a state credential (may be pending at time of hire) (Required)
  • ServSafe certification may be required depending on state and local licensing regulations (Required)

title: IT Service Desk Team Lead - Asset & Operations
description:
ASC is Australia’s submarine company. We built the Royal Australian Navy’s Collins Class submarines, sustain them, and are now delivering their Life of Type Extension to increase the boats’ service lives. We have also been selected by the Australian Government to sustain and jointly build the nation’s nuclear-powered submarines – the largest and most complex industrial undertaking in Australia’s history.

Our work is interesting and meaningful, contributing directly to Australia’s national security. We offer rewarding roles that provide the opportunity to grow your career, and the flexibility to balance life and work. A career at ASC is like no other, delivering a deeper purpose we can all be proud of.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and customer-focused Service Desk Team Leader to lead the day-to-day operations of our IT Service Desk function. Reporting to the IT Service Desk Manager, you will provide leadership, coaching and technical guidance to a team of Service Desk and Desktop Analysts, while ensuring the delivery of high-quality IT support across multiple locations. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines operational excellence, stakeholder engagement, continuous improvement and IT asset management governance to enhance the end-user experience across the organisation. The role plays a critical part in ensuring the organisation's technology assets are effectively managed, tracked, optimised and compliant throughout their lifecycle, while enhancing the overall end-user experience across the organisation.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach and mentor a team of Service Desk and Desktop Analysts, fostering a high-performance culture focused on accountability and service excellence.
  • Coordinate daily Service Desk operations, including workload prioritisation, resource management and escalation handling to ensure service continuity.
  • Monitor service performance and compliance with ITIL-aligned processes, service standards and operational procedures.
  • Act as a key escalation point for complex technical issues, providing guidance and support to team members and stakeholders.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives by refining processes, maintaining knowledge base content and developing work instructions.
  • Oversee IT asset lifecycle management activities, including deployment, refresh, recovery, disposal, auditing and compliance reporting.
  • Build strong stakeholder relationships across the business, delivering exceptional customer service and support to users at all levels, including senior executives.

About you

  • Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring or coordinating a Service Desk or End User Computing support team in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong technical troubleshooting capability across Windows environments, hardware, software, mobile devices, telecommunications and networking technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Active Directory, Microsoft Intune and ITSM/service management platforms.
  • Sound understanding of ITIL and IT Service Management principles, with the ability to drive process adherence and service improvements.
  • Proven experience managing IT asset lifecycle processes, governance, compliance requirements and audit readiness activities.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.
  • A proactive, solutions-focused leader who can work autonomously, manage competing priorities and build collaborative relationships across technology and business teams.

Eligibility

This role requires a current National Police Clearance and an Australian Defence Security Clearance to a NV1 level. Your eligibility for this role is dependent on you obtaining and maintaining such clearance.

Whilst ASC will accept all applications for this role, as this role requires an ability to access protected US defence technology, applicants holding nationality of certain foreign countries will not be eligible.

To check your eligibility please visit the Australian Government Security Vetting Agency website.

Benefits

  • Unique and challenging work with a deeper purpose.
  • Flexibility over how, when and where you work for the best work/life balance.
  • Up to 10 days additional leave every year so you can rest and recharge.
  • Generous parental leave so you can give your family the focus it deserves.
  • Subsidised childcare to ease the financial pressure on your family.
  • Health and wellbeing initiatives so you can perform at your best at work.
  • Professional development opportunities to advance your career.
  • A diverse and supportive environment where you can thrive.
  • Discounts and exclusive offers from leading Australian brands to help you save.

About ASC

Established in 1985, ASC’s 2500-plus staff offer a depth of submarine design, project management, supply chain, construction and engineering experience and expertise that is unparalleled in Australia’s defence industry. The company’s work on Australia’s nuclear-powered submarine build and the Collins Class Life of Type Extension takes place in Osborne, South Australia, with sustainment shared across Osborne and Henderson, Western Australia. ASC also plays a leading role in training Royal Australian Navy submariners.

description:
Who We Are

At ERC Pathlight, we’re on a mission to change lives—and we’re looking for people who feel called to do the same.

As one of the nation’s leading treatment providers for eating disorders and mood, anxiety, and trauma-related conditions, we bring innovative, evidence-based, and deeply compassionate care to patients across the country. With multiple locations nationwide and extensive virtual programming, we meet patients exactly where they are and help them move toward lasting recovery.

Founded in 2008 by renowned psychiatrists and psychologists, ERC Pathlight now supports more than 6,000 patients each year. And as the need for world-class mental health care continues to rise, our commitment is stronger than ever: to expand access, elevate the standard of care, and empower every patient to rebuild their life with dignity and hope.

Why Join Us

When you join ERC Pathlight, you become part of a team that shows up every day to make a real difference. You’ll work alongside passionate clinicians, dedicated support staff, and mission-driven leaders who believe in collaboration, growth, and doing the right thing—always.

Here, your work matters. Your ideas matter. You matter.

If you’re energized by purpose, motivated by impact, and ready to help transform the future of mental health treatment, you belong here.

Come build hope. Come save lives. Come grow with us.

What you’ll be doing:

Schedule: PRN 6:30am to 7pm

The Program Coordinator (PC I, PC II, PC III) is responsible for providing direct care and supervision to patients within inpatient, residential, and partial hospitalization levels of care at ERC Pathlight. Program Coordinators maintain a safe, structured, and therapeutic milieu while supporting the implementation of individualized treatment plans.

PCs provide patient supervision, maintain structure and boundaries, support therapeutic programming, assist with mealtime support, and complete required documentation. Level placement (I, II, III) is determined based on education, experience, and demonstrated competency.

Essential duties and responsibilities:

  • Milieu Management
  • Maintain daily program structure by following the established schedule
  • Complete observation rounds and safety checks as ordered by physician
  • Support patients with de-escalation and implementation of coping skills per treatment plan
  • Conduct room and luggage searches
  • Supervise fresh air breaks and mindful movement exposures
  • Provide ongoing bathroom monitoring
  • Obtain and document patient vital signs, weights, and urine specific gravity (as applicable by location/program)
  • Group Facilitation
  • Participate in facilitation of therapeutic groups
  • Complete required EHR documentation related to group facilitation
  • Support group-based social activities and meal outings
  • Meal Support
  • Participate in all meals and snacks with patients
  • Provide meal support using coaching and skills aligned with the treatment team
  • Complete timely and accurate meal-related documentation
  • Support dietitians in preparation for Nutrition and Cooking Groups
  • Ensure adherence to individualized meal plans and allergy-safety protocols
  • Support restaurant outings as needed
  • Administrative & Operational Support
  • Complete required documentation in compliance with organizational and regulatory standards, including patient observations, meals, and shift-related events
  • Provide patient transportation for medical appointments (as applicable by location/program)
  • Support additional transportation needs including outings, grocery procurement, or other facility needs
  • Assist with food procurement as needed (may occur weekly)
  • Distribute mail and packages daily

Position Expectations (All Levels)

  • All Program Coordinators must:
  • Be willing and able to work at all ERC Pathlight local sites as assigned
  • Be compliant with certification and regulatory requirements for each practice location
  • Maintain a flexible schedule to meet organizational staffing needs
  • Be available to work weekends and holidays as required
  • Be available to work on-call shifts based on business needs and in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local labor laws

Must haves:

Program Coordinator I (PC I)

  • High School Diploma or GED (Required)
  • Entry-level role: no prior direct patient care experience required unless required by state regulation (Required)

description:
Amazon Vendor Services (AVS) is looking for a Program Manager to join the Operations Excellence Experts team. The ideal candidate will have a passion for supply chain optimization and process improvement, good project management skills, experience interfacing with external companies (e.g. Vendors, Sellers, B2B customers), relationship building skills and the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders.

As an Operations Excellence Expert PM you will manage a small portfolio of Retail Vendors which rotate frequently (avg. 3-6 months engagement). You will evaluate the efficiency of the vendor's supply chain processes via data analysis and in person audit of the vendor's warehouses, identify root causes and improvement opportunities, prescribe improvement strategies, guide the improvement effort, and measure outcomes. In addition, you will work closely with internal stakeholders (e.g. Vendor Management, Supply Chain, Finance) to continuously improve the service and drive scalable processes/system improvements to eliminate defects.

- Analyze operational defects and identify root causes for financial deductions, define joint action plan with the vendor and enable implementation.
- Facilitate regular progress reviews with vendors to create sustainable long-term results.
- Cooperate and build trusting relationship across job functions and levels within the vendor's organization (e.g. Key Account Mgr, Supply Chain Mgr, Finance Mgr, CEO, Customer Service Mgr).
- Organize and run two-day Kaizen workshops with internal and external attendees including visits to the vendor's warehouse(s) and Amazon FCs. Lead group discussions, process mapping, value stream mapping and brain storming sessions.
- Work on cross-functional projects with internal stakeholders related to the improvement and growth of the service (e.g. expanding the value proposition, facilitating pitching and vendor outreach, increasing team productivity).
- Frequent traveling within EU is required for this role

About the team
Amazon Vendor Services team (AVS) develops programs to disproportionately grow vendors on Amazon and seeks to continuously enhance its value proposition to vendors. One of the new programs is the AVS Operations Excellence Expert Service, which is a specialized offering for Amazon Retail vendors who are facing supply chain defects leading to financial deductions. It provides a dedicated consultative service aimed to identify and sustainably resolve root causes of financial deductions.

title: Information Security Operations Manager
description:
Job Title: Information Security Operations Manager

Reporting to: Information Technology

Location: Head Office, White City Place, West London

Contract Type: Full time, 37.5 hours per week

​

​

​

​

​

​

About Us:

ME+EM is one of the UK’s fastest-growing luxury fashion brands. In addition to a thriving global digital presence, we operate flagship stores in London and Edinburgh, concessions within Harrods and Selfridges, and have recently expanded with new store openings in the U.S.

​

​

​

​


At ME+EM we are an entrepreneurial, creative, and passionate group of people. We work hard, are enthusiastic to learn and are not afraid to take risks. Everyone contributes to our success at all levels, and that precisely what makes being a member of the team so rewarding.

​

​

​

​

​


Our office and stores are always busy and fast paced, but we work just as hard to make sure it’s fun, with social activities and biannual parties. We pride ourselves on being approachable, supportive, and welcoming and ensure that everyone’s hard work is rewarded. It takes all these things to build a strong, successful business and our door is always open to new talent ready to contribute to our growth and evolution.

​

​

​

​

About the Role:

As ME+EM continues its rapid global expansion, protecting our brand identity, our intellectual property, and our customers’ data is paramount. We are looking for an operational leader to head our small but focused Information Security team. This is a "Player-Coach" role. You will line manage a talented Engineer and Analyst while remaining technically active, coordinating complex security projects across a range of departments. You are the bridge between high-level risk management and technical execution, ensuring that security enables - rather than hinders - our global growth.

​

​

​

​Job Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Orchestration

  • Direct Management: Lead, mentor, and set the roadmap for the Information Security Engineer and Analyst. Focus on career development and technical cross-skilling.
  • Workflow Management: Act as the "Traffic Controller" for the team, using Kanban to prioritise high-value tasks and ensuring the team stays focused on meaningful risk reduction rather than just "noise."
  • Cross-Functional Liaison: Partner with teams across the business to ensure "Security by Design" is integrated into every new project.

Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM)

  • Vendor Due Diligence: Own the end-to-end security assessment process for all new global partners (e.g., SaaS providers, 3PL warehouses, marketing agencies).
  • Continuous Monitoring: Implement a "Tiered Risk" framework to monitor existing partners, ensuring critical vendors meet our encryption, data handling, and availability standards.
  • Supply Chain Resilience: Assess the security posture of third-party APIs and integrations to prevent data leaks or service disruptions.

Operational Excellence & Incident Response

  • Incident Commander: Lead the response to information security incidents. Act as the primary escalation point, coordinating containment while providing clear, non-technical updates to business leadership.
  • Tooling & Automation: Oversee the optimisation of our security stack. Work with the Engineer to automate repetitive tasks and with the Analyst to improve threat detection accuracy.
  • Vulnerability Management: Oversee our global scanning programme. Prioritise remediation based on business impact - ensuring our systems and infrastructure remain resilient.

Security Validation & Pentesting

  • Pentest Ownership: Own the global Penetration Testing schedule, ensuring all critical outward-facing assets (website, head office, stores) are tested regularly.
  • Continuous Testing: Implement and oversee Continuous Security Testing or Attack Surface Management tools to identify vulnerabilities in real-time as our digital footprint scales.
  • Remediation Management: Don’t just "pass the report" to IT; work with the Engineer and Developers to validate fixes and ensure that high-risk findings are closed out within agreed SLAs.

Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)

  • Brand Protection: Manage DMARC and anti-phishing tools to defend ME+EM customers from fraudulent "copycat" websites and email scams.
  • Global Data Privacy: Ensure our operations remain compliant with UK/EU GDPR and PCI-DSS 4.0 as we scale into the US and other international markets.
  • Policy Maintenance: Ensure internal security policies are practical, up-to-date, and understood by the wider business.

​

​

​

​

The Ideal Candidate:

  • The Background: Experience in Cyber Security. You’ve likely been an Analyst or Engineer yourself and are ready to lead without losing your technical edge.
  • The Mindset: You understand that in a fast growing luxury fashion brand, our ability to move quickly is everything. You can design solutions that maintain security without compromising on the businesses ability to deliver for our customers.
  • The Tech Stack: Experience with enterprise Cloud Security (Google and Microsoft), EDR (e.g., SentinelOne), and SIEM.
  • Communication: You can explain a "SQL Injection" to a developer and a "Supply Chain Risk" to a Creative Director with equal clarity.



​

​

​

Employee Benefits:

  • 33 days annual leave for full time employees (25 days holiday + 8 bank holidays)
  • A day off to celebrate your birthday.

  • Enhanced maternity and paternity package after 2 years of service.

NIDEC Conversion is hiring a/an automation junior engineer for Genova site.

SUMMARY OF ROLE

Supports the design, implementation, testing and commissioning of PLC and SCADA/operator interface software for industrial automation solutions, primarily in steel plant automation and port quay electrification (cold ironing).

Works under the supervision of experienced automation engineers, contributing to development, testing and commissioning activities while progressively building technical competence and project autonomy.

PRINCIPLE JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Under guidance of senior engineers:

· Support analysis of project specifications and functional requirements.

· Participate in development and configuration of PLC and SCADA software.

· Support preparation of validation procedures, reports and technical documentation.

· Participate in integration of software with automation hardware and industrial communication networks.

· Participate in testing, debugging and validation activities.

· Participate in commissioning activities

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS

Areas Frequency

Italy and abroadFrequency not fixed;

REQUIRED EDUCATION, QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE and LANGUAGES

Education and Qualifications

Technical high school diploma in Information Technology or Electronics, Electrical Engineering or Industrial Automation. Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Electronics, or Industrial Automation considered an advantage.

Experience

0-3 years, including internships, apprenticeships or university projects

Languages

· Italian: C1 / C2 – Full professional proficiency (spoken and written)

· English: B2 – Professional working proficiency (spoken and written)

CORE COMPETENCIES

Required knowledge includes:

· Basic knowledge of PLCs preferably Siemens platforms

· Basic knowledge of SCADA systems (WinCC, InTouch, Zenon or equivalent).

· Fundamentals of industrial communication networks.

· Basic understanding of electrical systems, sensors, actuators, motors and drives.

· Basic ability to read electrical diagrams and technical documentation.

· Familiarity with Microsoft Office tools

Genova, Italy

Hybrid

#LI-ES1

Range 30-35 k

ABOUT US

Nidec Conversion is a $600M Business Unit of Nidec Corporation, a $18 Billion+ global company, headquartered in Milan (Italy) and footprint in more than 10 countries. Nidec Industrial Solutions offers complete, innovative and tailored electrical systems for energy efficiency to hundreds of customers worldwide. Its target markets are traditional and renewable energy, steel, petrochemical, marine, industrial automation and emerging segments in energy field. The global organization specializes in designing, engineering, commissioning and service complex applications with electric motors and generators, electronic power converters and inverters, automation and software for industrial processes, complete electric solutions, retrofitting of power plants and hydroelectric generators. In addition, the group has strong know-how in the field of integrated systems for the production and storage of electrical energy from renewable sources and their integration into electricity grids, as well as in the design and implementation of infrastructures for e-mobility.

Nidec is committed to ensuring equal opportunities and promoting all qualified individuals regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, disability, age, sexual orientation and identity.

title: Työnjohtaja
description:
Etsimme nyt työnjohtajia Keski-Suomeen vakituiseen työsuhteeseen

Omexom toimii Suomessa energianjakelun koko ketjun parissa tuotannosta siirto- ja jakeluverkkoihin. Tarjoamme avaimet käteen -projekteja, palveluita ja kunnossapitoa. Omexom työllistää noin 500 työntekijää ympäri Suomen.

Tehtäväsi on vastata sähköverkon rakentamiseen liittyvien projektien ja työkohteiden johtamisesta omalla vastuualueellasi. Johdat työmaiden operatiivista toimintaa yhteistyössä asiakkaiden, viranomaisten, alihankkijoiden sekä muiden sidosryhmien kanssa.

Varmistat, että projektit etenevät turvallisesti, aikataulussa ja sovittujen laatuvaatimusten mukaisesti. Vastaat myös projektiesi taloudellisesta onnistumisesta, tavoitteiden saavuttamisesta sekä talousennusteiden laatimisesta annettujen aikataulujen mukaisesti.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää useamman vuoden kokemusta vastaavista työtehtävistä. Verkostoasentajan töiden kokemus katsotaan eduksi, sillä tehtävässä on mahdollista myös osallistua varallaoloon ja viankorjaukseen.

Työhönottopaikka on Jyväskylä tai Saarijärvi.

Toivomme sinulta

· Sähköalan koulutusta

· Kokemusta sähköverkkoliiketoiminnasta

· Kokemusta työmaiden johtamisesta

· Turvallisuuslähtöistä ajattelutapaa ja sitoutumista turvallisiin työtapoihin

· Organisointi- ja tiiminvetokykyä

· Hyviä yhteistyötaitoja

· Hyvää suullista ja kirjallista suomen kielen taitoa

Työturvallisuus on toimintamme perusta, ja odotamme sinulta työnjohtajana vahvaa turvallisuusajattelua sekä kykyä johtaa projekteja ja työkohteita turvallisuus edellä. Huolehdit siitä, että turvalliset toimintatavat toteutuvat käytännössä ja että jokainen pääsee työpäivän päätteeksi turvallisesti kotiin.

Meidän tiimissämme pääset osaksi ammattitaitoista ja rentoa työporukkaa. Kollegoilta saa tukea ja neuvoja, ja vahva yhteishenki näkyy arjen tekemisessä. Meillä jokainen on tärkeä ja arvostettu osa porukkaa.

Meillä Omexomilla toimintaa ohjaa viisi arvoa: luottamus, autonomia, vastuullisuus, yrittäjähenkisyys ja solidaarisuus. Ne näkyvät arjessamme – tavassamme tehdä töitä, kohdata toisemme ja kehittää yhteistä tulevaisuutta. Meillä arvostetaan hyvää tiimihenkeä, työn monipuolisuutta, yhdessä onnistumista sekä mahdollisuutta oppia uutta ja kehittyä. Jaamme osaamista, tuemme toisiamme ja rakennamme yhdessä kestävää tulevaisuutta.

Tarjoamme palkkaa, joka vastaa tehtävän vaativuutta ja omaa osaamistasi – reilusti ja läpinäkyvästi. Palkkauksen perustana on Energiateollisuuden toimihenkilöiden TES.

Meillä pääset työskentelemään yhteiskunnan toiminnan kannalta keskeisellä alalla ja osallistumaan energiamurroksen toteuttamiseen osana globaalia verkostoamme.

Tuntuuko tehtävä sinulle sopivalta? Kiinnostuitko mahdollisuudesta työskennellä meillä?

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten kannattaa toimia nopeasti! Täytä hakemus ja kerro tarkemmin itsestäsi ja osaamisestasi 30.8.2026 mennessä.

Lisätietoa tehtävästä antaa

10.–18.8. Laura Rossi 0407176085, laura.rossi@omexom.com

19.–28.8. Juho Skantz 0400561917, juho.skantz@omexom.com

Tietoa työnantajasta

Energia-alan jatkuvien muutosten keskellä Omexom auttaa asiakkaitaan saavuttamaan energiasiirtymän tavoitteet. Hyödyntäen laaja-alaista osaamistaan sähkö- ja kaasualalla, Omexom rakentaa vähähiilisiä energialähteitä, kehittää sähköverkkoa, edistää energian tehokasta käyttöä sekä toteuttaa innovatiivisia ja yhteistyöhön perustuvia ratkaisuja.

Projektimme ja palvelumme ovat suunnattuja energiantuottajille, siirto- ja jakeluverkkoyhtiöille, paikallis- ja alueviranomaisille sekä niiden käyttäjille kaikilla alueilla. Omexom etsii jatkuvasti parhaita teknologisia vaihtoehtoja ja toteuttaa asiakkailleen soveltuvimmat ratkaisut täysin riippumattomana toimittajista.

Omexom on VINCI Energiesin energia-alan ratkaisuihin erikoistunut brändi.

title: C++ Software Engineer
description:
C++ Software Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a C++ Software Engineer who wants to build low-latency trading infrastructure on Linux. You'll work on the core components of our Switchboard trading platform — pricing engines, connectivity gateways, market-data systems, and the messaging layer that ties them together.

This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall. You build it, you test it, you deploy it, you support it in production, and you improve it. Our engineers own the full lifecycle — from design through to operational excellence. When something breaks at 4pm on a Friday, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

What You'll Work On

  • Modern C++20 and Go on Linux — a modern software stack based on open source

  • Cloud-native infrastructure on AWS with colocation in key data centres

  • Microsecond-level latency optimisation and high-throughput messaging

  • Market-data and reference-data pipelines across multiple asset classes

  • FIX protocol integrations with global banks and liquidity providers

  • Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make system behaviour visible

  • Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong C++ with Linux systems programming (3+ years)

  • Comfortable working close to the metal — you understand what's underneath your code

  • Experience with performance-sensitive systems (profiling, optimisation, deterministic behaviour)

  • Familiarity with networking fundamentals (TCP/UDP, socket programming)

  • Go experience is a strong bonus — we use Go extensively for microservices and command-line tooling, and you'll be expected to work with it internally. If you don't know it yet, strong C++ engineers pick it up quickly

  • Python for scripting, automation, testing, and data analysis — used across the platform for tooling and operational workflows

  • Git and shell scripting

  • Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop

  • You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential

  • You care about quality. You write clean, testable code. You review your peers' work thoughtfully. You push for continuous improvement without gold-plating

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real problems — trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

  • Growth — career progression to senior roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition
Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager
Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our .

title: Senior Software Developer
description:
Company Description

Founded in 1989 and headquartered in Reston, Virginia, SOSi is a private defense and government solutions business specializing in advanced technology systems and mission support. Its capabilities include data science, software development, network engineering, intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR), and logistics.

Job Description

SOSi is seeking highly skilled Software Developers to join our analytics team working on an innovative MLOps workload leveraging cutting-edge technologies and supporting a government customer in Huntsville, Alabama. This role will be responsible for delivering automation to key national security missions interacting with petabyte-scale data on an HPC.

In this role, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and maintaining MSIC software applications. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions that meet our clients' needs. Your expertise in Python, Docker, NoSQL, SQL, and Apache Airflow/Kafka will be crucial in driving our projects forward.

Essential Job Duties

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications using Python.
  • Design, implement, and manage scalable MLOps pipelines and infrastructure.
  • Develop and manage containerized applications using Docker.
  • Work with NoSQL and SQL for database management and optimization.
  • Implement and manage data workflows using Apache Airflow and Kafka.
  • Automate the training, testing, and deployment of machine learning models.
  • Implement and manage APIs and ensure their scalability, reliability, and performance.
  • Implement and manage infrastructure as code and configuration management tools.
  • Collaborate with data scientists to integrate machine learning models into applications.
  • Design and develop microservices architecture for scalability and efficiency.
  • Write clean, scalable, and efficient code.
  • Participate in the entire software development lifecycle, from concept and design to testing and deployment.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing software.
  • Provides leadership, support and guidance to all AIMS Team Members.
  • Ensures and promotes the development of the AIMS team through coaching, training, and leadership development.
  • Provides informal feedback on an ongoing basis and formal feedback in the annual performance evaluation process to identify and develop talent.
Qualifications
  • Top Secret Security Clearance with SCI eligibility.
  • 7+ years of experience in software development, MLOps, DevOps, or related roles.
  • Proficiency in Python and experience with its frameworks.
  • Extensive knowledge of containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI) and automated testing.
  • Experience with version control systems (Git, SVN).
  • Hands-on experience with NoSQL and SQL.
  • Proficient in using Apache Airflow for workflow management.
  • Proficiency with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
  • Solid understanding of software architecture and design patterns.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks efficiently.
  • Experience with agile development methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Familiarity with event-driven architecture and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
  • Experience with feature stores and model registries.
  • Familiarity with big data technologies (Spark, Hadoop)
  • Knowledge of monitoring and logging tools for machine learning models (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack).
  • Significant experience with petabyte scale data sets.
  • Significant experience with large-scale, multi-INT analytics.
Additional Information

Work Environment

  • Working conditions are normal for an office environment.
  • Fast paced, deadline-oriented environment.
  • May require periods of non-traditional working hours including consecutive nights or weekends (if applicable).

Working at SOSi

All interested individuals will receive consideration and will not be discriminated against for any reason.

CareDx offers products, testing services, and digital healthcare solutions along the pre- and post-transplant patient journey, and is the leading provider of genomics-based information for transplant patients.

Market Shaping & Disease Leadership

Upstream Marketing Leadership

  • Lead indication strategy, value proposition, and positioning by tumor type

Downstream Marketing & Activation

  • Lead downstream marketing teams responsible for campaigns, congress strategy, and field enablement
  • Ensure translation of strategy into field-ready programs that accelerate adoption

Medical Affairs, MSL & Medical Education Leadership

  • Provide strategic leadership to MSL and Medical Education teams
  • Own the integrated medical plan including scientific exchange, advisory boards, and education
  • Ensure compliant, high-impact engagement with multidisciplinary care teams

Sales Team Leadership (In the nearterm)

  • Manage a 2nd line sales leader and the sales team
  • Translate franchise strategy into sales priorities and targeting
  • Partner with Sales Ops and Sales Excellence to ensure world-class sales execution and management cadence
  • Partner with Commercial Operations to deliver forecasting, demand planning, and performance insights

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Act as single point of accountability for franchise alignment across functions
  • Drive disciplined execution through data-driven decision making
  • Represent the franchise in executive and strategic planning forums

Qualifications & Experience

  • Advanced degree preferred (MBA, PhD, PharmD, MD)
  • 12+ years in oncology, molecular diagnostics, or biopharma
  • Proven franchise or portfolio leadership experience
  • Deep experience across upstream/downstream marketing and medical collaboration
  • Strong matrix leadership and influence skills

Leadership Characteristics

  • Enterprise mindset with full accountability
  • Strategic clarity combined with operational rigor
  • Collaborative leader with credibility across Sales and Medical
  • High integrity with strong compliance orientation

Every individual at CareDx has a direct impact on our collective mission to improve the lives of organ transplant patients worldwide. We believe in taking great care of our people, so they take even greater care of our patients.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Aveni is redefining how financial institutions use AI. We build real, production-ready agentic systems that reshape how banks, advisers and financial services firms operate, replacing fragmented processes with intelligent, end-to-end workflows.

We have been recognised as Fintech of the Year for two consecutive years and awarded Best Specialist Technology Service at the Professional Adviser Awards 2025. Backed by leading investors including Puma Private Equity, and commercially supported by Lloyds Banking Group and Nationwide Building Society, we previously completed one of Scotland’s largest Series A rounds. Since then, we’ve continued to grow rapidly as adoption of AI in financial services accelerates, and we’re now scaling our engineering organisation to meet that demand.

Our engineering team includes experienced software engineers and PhD-level AI specialists, with strong ties to the University of Edinburgh, giving you access to exceptional expertise and opportunities for continuous learning as part of the day-to-day work.

The role

We're looking for a Lead AI Software Engineer to be the most senior technical voice in one of our product squads, working as a technical co-leader alongside the Engineering Manager. You'll own the squad's technical direction and engineering quality end to end, from architectural decision making and hands-on delivery, to mentoring engineers and shaping how we build across the organisation. This role demands genuine depth in AI. You'll be leading LLM powered feature development and setting the standard for how AI tooling amplifies the whole engineering process, combined with the full-stack and cloud-native chops to back it up.

What you'll be doing

  • Setting technical direction for your squad. Owning architectural decisions, managing technical risk, and representing the engineering perspective at our Architecture Review Board

  • Driving adoption of AI coding tools across the full SDLC, from planning and design through code review, testing, deployment and setting the bar for how the squad works

  • Delivering production grade code across the full stack: Node.js or Python backends, event-driven AWS architecture, and React where the squad needs it

  • Mentoring and growing engineers across AI and full-stack domains, through code reviews, design documents, and day-to-day pairing

  • Collaborating with platform teams to consume shared capabilities and contribute reusable patterns back, not building one-off solutions when a platform component will do

  • Ensuring everything we ship is compliant-by-design, auditable, and built to the standards expected of software in FCA regulated financial services

What we're looking for

  • A seasoned engineer with 10+ years of experience, including meaningful time building and operating AI/ML systems in production

  • Real technical leadership. You've set direction, made architectural calls, mentored others, and influenced how a team builds, not just what it ships

  • Strong hands-on AI/LLM skills: prompt engineering, RAG, model evaluation and agent frameworks. You know how these work in production, not just in demos

  • Deep expertise in Node.js, with solid experience in the other; comfortable switching contexts depending on what the problem needs

  • Cloud-native development on AWS. Serverless, event-driven, Lambda, with an instinct for well designed, maintainable systems

  • A genuine curiosity about where AI is going and the judgment to separate signal from noise when recommending what to adopt

  • An instinct for building responsibly. You care about auditability, compliance, and the downstream impact of what you ship

Why Aveni

  • You'll work at the frontier of applied AI in a domain where it actually matters, helping financial services firms serve their clients better and meet growing regulatory obligations

  • AI-native engineering culture: we use AI tools seriously, across the full development process, and we're always looking to push further

  • High impact from day one. As a Staff Engineer, your technical decisions will shape the product, the platform, and the engineers around you

  • A talented, collaborative team building something genuinely novel, with the backing, the architecture, and the proprietary models to do it properly

Benefits at Aveni

What you’ll love

  • Remote-first working across the UK.

  • Work abroad policy for when you want a change of scenery.

  • Co-working spaces available if you want an office buzz sometimes.

  • 34 days holiday (including flexible bank holidays) and your birthday off.

  • Company-wide off-sites (yes, karaoke may happen).

  • Optional Personal Development Plan.

  • Flexible benefits platform: you choose the benefits that matter most to you (not the company).

  • Protection essentials, because we know they matter - Life Insurance, Income protection, critical illness cover, Pension (up to 5% matched employer contribution and optional increased contributions).

  • Private health- and dental care for your peace of mind.

  • Potential share options, have a stake in what you’re building.

  • Enhanced family leave.

Join Us in Making a Difference

At Aveni, we believe that diversity drives innovation. We've built our business to ensure an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best work. If you're passionate about technology and its ability to drive positive change for the future of financial services, we'd love to hear from you.

Even if you don’t meet 100% of requirements, we’d like to hear from you anyway if you believe you’d fit in. Apply now to join us on our mission to transform the financial services industry through AI.

title: Product Manager - Network Management
description:
​
Job reference 340363
Product Manager - Network Management
Competitive salary, plus £4,200 car allowance, healthcare, 18% annual bonus potential, 27.5 days annual leave plus bank holidays rising with service and a company pension scheme with highly competitive contribution rates
Permanent, Full time

National role working 4 days in your local office

We're building one of the UK's fastest-growing parcel locker networks and are looking for a Product Manager for our Out of Home Network to help shape its future.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing team responsible for scaling our Out of Home network and creating the systems, processes and capabilities needed to support long-term growth. You'll play a key role in ensuring our locker estate remains reliable, efficient and ready to support increasing customer and carrier demand. If you enjoy solving complex operational challenges, working across technology and operations, and thinking about how today's decisions support tomorrow's growth, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

As Product Manager for OOH Network Management, you'll be responsible for the tools, processes and infrastructure capabilities that keep our locker network running effectively. Working closely with Operations, Technology, Deployment, Maintenance and supplier partners, you'll help improve network performance while shaping the future roadmap for how the network scales.

This isn't a role focused purely on keeping today's network running. We're looking for someone who can think strategically about the future of the estate, identify opportunities for automation and improvement, and help build solutions that are scalable, sustainable and capable of supporting significant future growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and drive the roadmap for network management capabilities, ensuring the network can scale efficiently as it grows.
  • Lead the integration of new locker hardware, infrastructure components and supplier-delivered solutions.
  • Own and prioritise a data-driven backlog focused on network reliability, availability and operational efficiency.
  • Analyse operational and infrastructure data to identify trends, risks and long-term improvement opportunities.
  • Work with suppliers, technology teams and operational stakeholders to deliver scalable solutions and improvements.
  • Establish performance measures and continuous improvement processes that drive network resilience and growth.

About You

You're a curious and forward-thinking Product Manager who enjoys tackling real-world operational challenges. You can balance immediate business needs with long-term thinking and are motivated by building products, processes and capabilities that will stand the test of time.

You'll be comfortable working in an evolving environment where not every process is already defined, bringing a combination of analytical thinking, problem-solving and strong stakeholder management skills. Most importantly, you'll enjoy turning complex problems into practical, scalable solutions.

What You'll Bring

  • Experience in Product Management, Product Ownership or Business Analysis within a software, technology or operational environment.
  • Strong backlog management, user story creation and Agile delivery experience.
  • Experience using data and insight to prioritise activity and improve performance.
  • Strong systems-thinking capability and the ability to design scalable solutions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills across technical, operational and supplier environments.
  • Experience within logistics, infrastructure, retail operations, IoT or hardware-enabled products would be advantageous.

Role Impact

This role will help shape how our Out of Home network evolves over the coming years. You'll influence how infrastructure is monitored, how operational issues are prevented, and how systems and processes are designed to support future growth. Your work will directly contribute to building a smarter, more resilient and more scalable network.

Extra Benefits

• Family friendly support - enhanced maternity pay, paternity leave, adoption leave and shared parental leave
• Supportive and generous company sick pay
• Funded Dental – As a manager you are eligible to a level of employer funded dental insurance*
• Health Assessment – As a manager you are eligible to an employer funded health assessment every 2 years*
• Benefits Account – You will have access to your personal benefits account on our ‘My Bundle+’ platform. There are more than 800 retail offers to help you save on things like groceries, days out, holidays and your household bills as well as employer provided and voluntary benefits to suit your lifestyle.
• Your Wellbeing - you and your family have 24/7 access to services and tools to help you get the most out of life. From your physical and mental health to financial and social support and advice. It’s free, and it’s for everyone.

*Available only to permanent employees

Next Steps

The next stage of the selection process will be a face to face/virtual interview consisting of competency based and role specific questions. We plan to hold interviews on OR w/c XXXX virtually/at XXXXX. (Please adjust as necessary)

title: Nômade Temple Ibiza - Journey Designer
description:
About Nômade Temple Ibiza

Nômade Temple Ibiza is a sanctuary where nature, wellbeing, culture, and community come together to create transformative experiences. Nestled in the north of the island, we offer a slower, more conscious way of experiencing Ibiza, inviting guests to reconnect with themselves, others, and the natural world through thoughtfully curated programming, meaningful hospitality, exceptional gastronomy, and immersive rituals.

Your Role

As a Journey Designer, you will create highly personalized and meaningful guest experiences before, during, and after each stay. You will anticipate guest needs, curate tailored journeys, and serve as a trusted guide to both the Nômade universe and the authentic spirit of Ibiza. Through emotional intelligence, creativity, and genuine hospitality, you will design unforgettable experiences that reflect each guest's intentions while embodying the Nômade philosophy.

Beyond designing experiences, you will be an active host within the property, bringing our daily wellness programming, immersive journeys, community gatherings, and special activations to life while ensuring every guest feels welcomed, connected, and cared for.

What You Will Do

  • Conduct personalized conversations to understand each guest's intentions, interests, lifestyle, emotional needs, and travel motivations.

  • Design and curate bespoke itineraries integrating wellbeing, gastronomy, nature, culture, music, rituals, adventure, and local experiences.

  • Recommend and coordinate wellness sessions, immersive journeys, outdoor adventures, cultural experiences, beach escapes, and island discoveries tailored to each guest.

  • Proactively connect with guests prior to arrival to understand expectations and personalize their stay.

  • Maintain warm, attentive, and consistent communication with guests before, during, and after their stay.

  • Welcome guests upon arrival and act as their trusted point of contact throughout their journey.

  • Introduce guests to the Nômade community, daily programming, facilitators, and signature experiences, fostering meaningful human connections.

  • Welcome, host, and facilitate a seamless guest experience during wellness classes, ceremonies, workshops, immersive journeys, retreats, cultural events, and community gatherings.

  • Prepare, set up, and maintain wellness spaces, ritual areas, and programming venues, ensuring they are beautifully presented, fully equipped, and aligned with Nômade's service, operational, and aesthetic standards.

  • Support the execution of special programming activations, retreats, seasonal events, brand collaborations, private experiences, and community gatherings, ensuring flawless execution from setup to completion.

  • Monitor the quality and flow of experiences in real time, anticipating guest and operational needs while resolving issues with professionalism and care.

  • Coordinate seamlessly with Front Office, Guest Relations, Wellness, Food & Beverage, Programming, Housekeeping, and other operational teams to deliver exceptional service.

  • Continuously identify opportunities to surprise, delight, and elevate the guest journey.

  • Monitor guest feedback and adapt experiences in real time according to evolving preferences and needs.

  • Maintain detailed guest profiles and personalization notes to ensure meaningful relationships across future stays.

  • Ensure every interaction and recommendation reflects Nômade's philosophy, storytelling, service standards, and brand identity.

  • Collaborate closely with Guest Relations while maintaining clear ownership of the Journey Designer role.

  • Support the ongoing development and evolution of guest experiences, seasonal programming, and immersive offerings.

  • Participate actively in daily briefings, operational meetings, and cross-department collaboration.

  • Perform any additional duties consistent with the role as assigned by Management.

Who We're Looking For

  • Naturally intuitive, empathetic, and passionate about creating exceptional guest experiences.

  • A genuine host with a deep appreciation for hospitality, wellbeing, culture, and meaningful human connection.

  • Strong emotional intelligence with the ability to understand both spoken and unspoken guest needs.

  • Excellent communication, listening, and relationship-building skills.

  • Creative, curious, and passionate about designing memorable experiences.

  • Deep knowledge of Ibiza, including its beaches, nature, wellness scene, gastronomy, culture, music, hidden gems, and local community.

  • Excellent taste, attention to detail, and sensitivity to diverse guest preferences.

  • Calm, warm, professional, and highly adaptable in a dynamic hospitality environment.

  • Proactive, organized, and capable of managing multiple guest journeys simultaneously.

  • Hands-on, operationally minded, and comfortable supporting both planning and on-the-ground execution.

  • Collaborative mindset with strong operational awareness and follow-through.

  • Positive, flexible, and solution-oriented attitude.

  • Well-presented and aligned with a luxury lifestyle and wellbeing hospitality environment.

Requirements

  • Previous experience in luxury hospitality, concierge, guest experience, travel design, lifestyle hospitality, events, or wellbeing is highly valued.

  • Experience designing or curating personalized guest experiences is a strong advantage.

  • Experience hosting events, wellness programming, retreats, or community experiences is highly desirable.

  • Excellent knowledge of Ibiza's hospitality, wellness, gastronomy, cultural, and lifestyle landscape.

  • Strong emotional maturity and outstanding interpersonal skills.

  • Fluent English and Spanish are required; additional languages are highly valued.

  • Valid EU work permit.

title: General Application (m/f/d)
description:
About the role

Agile Robots builds robots that combine AI, software, and hardware into working products, sold to industrial and research customers. Building that requires people across a wide range of disciplines, and our open roles don't always cover every background that could contribute. If you don't see a current opening that matches yours but believe your experience fits one of the areas below, we welcome a general application.

Your Responsibilities

Areas we hire into:
  • Robotics & Automation: Mechatronics, motion control, robotic arm or mobile platform engineering, industrial automation and PLC/controls work. Covers both the design of robotic hardware and its integration into customer production environments.
  • AI & Machine Learning: Model design, robot learning, computer vision, world models, applied AI for real hardware. Spans research-level model work and the applied engineering that gets a model running reliably on a physical robot.
  • Software: Robotics runtime and middleware, embedded and firmware development, cloud and platform infrastructure, application software for robotic systems. Ranges from low-level device code to the software platforms that let a robot be programmed and monitored.
  • Hardware & Electrical: PCB design, sensor and actuator integration, power electronics, controls hardware. Includes both product-level electronics design and the shopfloor-facing electrical work that keeps a deployed system running.
  • Product & Program Management: Technical program management, product ownership for software or hardware platforms, cross-functional delivery. Coordinates work across engineering disciplines and keeps a product's roadmap and delivery on track.
  • Sales & Customer-Facing: Sales engineering, technical account management, customer deployment and support. Covers the technical relationship with customers from first contact through live deployment.
  • Operations & Supply Chain: Manufacturing support, procurement, production readiness. Bridges engineering and the production of physical hardware at scale.
  • Corporate Functions: Finance, People, Marketing, and other business functions supporting the company. Keeps the business itself running so the technical teams can build.

Your Profile

What to include: Your background, which area above fits it best, what you'd want to work on and why that area interests you.

What happens next: We review general applications periodically rather than on a fixed schedule. If your profile matches a current or upcoming need, we'll reach out. If nothing fits right now, your application stays on file for future openings; you don't need to reapply when a relevant role opens. We're not able to send an individual response to every submission.

What we offer

  • Dynamic high-tech company combined with financial soundness and world class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities in the context of our continued growth.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program that covers health, mobility and learning with 100 € net per month.
  • Modern office facilites with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment.

About us

Agile Robots SE is an international high-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than 2300 employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state-of-the-art force-moment-sensing and world-leading image-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly.

This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us!

We are proud of our diversity and welcome your application regardless of gender and sexual identity, nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, or disability.

title: Personlig assistent sökes till kvinna i Vänersborg
description:
På Olivia arbetar vi tillsammans för alla människors rätt till att leva livet fullt ut. Nu söker vi ytterligare en kollega till vårt team, är det du?

Om tjänsten

Vi på Olivia som nu söker dig som vill arbeta som personlig assistent till vår kvinnliga kund i Vänersborg.

Vår kund har assistans dygnets alla timmar och har dubbel assistans dag samt kvällstid. Hon tycker om att vara ute i naturen, växter och träning.

Vi söker dig som vill arbeta deltid cirka 36% under nattetid. Vi söker även dig som vill arbeta som vikarie vid behov vid ordinarie assistenters frånvaro vid tex semester eller sjukdom.

Kunden önskar kvinnliga assistenter.

Arbetstiderna är förlagda enligt följande:

  • Kl. 07.00–16.00

  • Kl. 08.00–16.00

  • Kl. 16.00–21.45

  • Kl. 17.00–08.00 (Väntetid 5h)

Arbetsuppgifterna är enligt följande:

  • Hjälpa till med de dagliga rutinerna såsom förekommande hushållssysslor

  • Assistera vid personlig hygien, av- och påklädning samt vid måltider


Om dig:

Vi tror att du som söker denna tjänst är en person som tycker om att arbeta med människor och som kan se till andra människors behov. Som person är du lyhörd, initiativtagare samt lösningsfokuserad.

Du besitter ett lugn och en personlig mognad och att du är trygg i dig själv. Som timvikarie måste kunna arbeta varierande arbetspass vardag som helg,sovande jourpass med väntetid förekommer.

Krav:

  • Yrkesmässig erfarenhet av arbete som personlig assistent eller inom vård och omsorg

  • Flytande svenska i tal och skrift

Meriter:

  • Körkort och tillgång till egen bil

Sysselsättningsgrad: 1 tjänst deltid cirka 36%, 1 timvikarie vid behov.

Tillträde: Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.

Lön: Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Övriga ersättningar i enlighet med kollektivavtal.


Att tänka på inför din ansökan:

En förutsättning för att påbörja en anställning hos på Olivia är att du som söker kan uppvisa giltig ID-handling och lämna in personbevis samt eventuella dokument som styrker rätten till arbete inom Sverige. Personbevis kan du enkelt ladda ned på Skatteverkets hemsida.

För att arbeta som personlig assistent hos oss måste du ha fyllt 18 år. Ålderskravet följer av reglerna om personlig assistans, ledsagning och avlösning i LSS och socialförsäkringsbalken.


För att arbeta med barn och unga under 18 år krävs att du uppvisar utdrag ur belastningsregistret. Från och med den 1 mars 2026 gäller nya bestämmelser som innebär att registerkontrollen omfattar både utdrag ur belastningsregistret och utdrag ur misstankeregistret. Utdragen beställs via Polismyndighetens e-tjänst. Observera att handläggningstiden kan variera, varför beställning bör göras i god tid.

Utdragen kan beställas med BankID via följande länk:

Om rekryteringsprocessen:

Om du ger ditt samtycke kan vi dela din profil med våra systerbolag om din profil matchar en annan tjänst inom Team Olivia.

För dig med Anställningsstöd:

Olivia är ett inkluderande företag. Vi välkomnar alla sökanden och även du som har rätt till någon form av anställningsstöd genom arbetsförmedlingen. Det är frivilligt att ange denna information i din ansökan, alternativt kan du även meddela detta vid en eventuell intervju.

Om kollektivavtal hos Olivia:

Som medarbetare omfattas du av kollektivavtal och självklart är du försäkrad på och till/från arbetet om något oförutsett skulle inträffa. Förutom friskvårdsbidrag och en rad andra förmåner anordnar vi aktiviteter som riktar sig både till dig som anställd och till kunden du arbetar med.
