title: Service Desk Engineer
description:
As a Service Desk Engineer at Platinum Technology, you’ll be the communication superhero our clients rely on. We’re seeking individuals with excellent communication skills, a customer-centric mindset, and empathy towards our clients. While desktop support experience is necessary, we value candidates eager to learn about Cloud, Security, Networking, and Project work. Expertise in technologies such as End User Compute, Cloud and Hybrid Infrastructure, Networking, and Microsoft Teams Calling is essential for resolving technical inquiries and providing exceptional customer experiences. Your primary responsibility entails resolving requests and incidents received on the front line. Additionally, you will be expected to collaborate effectively with our Service Desk – Level 2 team to resolve those inquiries on your own where possible.

How you will make an impact

  • Be the first line of support, responding to inbound calls, emails, and online chats professionally and efficiently.
  • Engage in respectful interactions with clients, attending to their technology requirements and resolving requests and incidents to their satisfaction.
  • Own all tickets through to resolution, ensuring accurate logging and constant tracking within our ticketing system, keeping clients updated on enquiries they have submitted
  • Collaborate with the Service Desk – Level 2 team, Senior Technical Engineers and External Vendors to resolve incidents and service requests independently.
  • Monitor client backups, hardware failures, and business-critical applications to address issues proactively.
  • Create, maintain, and update internal documentation, providing feedback for ongoing improvement.
  • Proactively identify areas for improvement and make recommendations to enhance our services.
  • Support cloud solutions, including Microsoft 365, Azure AD, and AWS services.
  • Support on-premises infrastructure, including servers, end-user devices, network products, 3rd party applications, and hardware, among other responsibilities.
  • Stay up to date with technology, industry trends, and developments.
  • Collaborate closely with our Onsite Services Engineers, Senior Technical Engineers, and Management team.
  • Collaborate closely with our Lead Service Desk Engineers, Service Desk Engineers – Level 2 and Service Desk Manager

About You

  • Must have Australian working rights.
  • Strong work ethic and honesty.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and oral communication skills.
  • Good time management and organisational skills.
  • Punctuality and reliability.
  • Customer Service Experience
  • IT Technical Support or a similar role.
  • High level of customer service skills, able to relate to stakeholders at all levels.
  • Practical communication skills with clients of diverse backgrounds and technical knowledge.
  • Technical knowledge in Desktop Support and Microsoft 365.
  • Strong problem-solving skills to efficiently address complex technical issues.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team, with a proactive and solutions-oriented mindset.
  • High self-motivation, adaptability, and willingness to take on new responsibilities.

Highly Desirable

  • IT Service Desk Experience
  • Attention to detail and accuracy in documentation.
  • Demonstrated experience analysing and improving business processes.
  • Knowledge of working with IT Ticketing Systems including ConnectWise (Manage/Automate)
  • Technical knowledge in Azure AD, Network Administration and Security Principals
  • Fundamental Microsoft certifications including Modern Workplace (MS900) and Azure (AZ900)
  • Administration-level Microsoft certifications including Modern Workplace (MS100) and Azure (AZ104)
  • ITIL / ITSM certifications
  • Tertiary Education in Information Technology (Degree and/or Diploma)

What’s in it for you?

  • Inspiring Work Culture: Become an integral part of an award-winning company, where our commitment to creating an inspiring work culture is reflected in several accolades, including being a finalist in the Australian Financial Review’s Best Place to Work in 2022. Experience genuine values that we live by, which is excellence, responsibility, urgency, care, integrity and teamwork.
  • Rewards and Recognition: As a valued team member, excellence is not only recognised but celebrated through various awards, including Team Member of the Month, Team Member of the Year, Service Awards, Smile Back Awards, and Book Worm Awards.
  • Meaningful Benefits: We understand the importance of maintaining a healthy work-life balance, which is why we provide paid birthday leave, study leave, well-being leave, and an Active Employee Program.
  • Dynamic Journey: We offer a dynamic and enriching work experience where every day brings on new challenges and opportunities. Working with MSP, you will immerse yourself in a diverse technical landscape, working with various technologies and collaborating with different individuals daily.

About Platinum Technology

Platinum Technology is an Asia Pacific-based organisation established in 2010, with the Head Office in Sydney. We specialise in IT Managed and Enterprise Consulting services for mid-market and large organisations. With deep technical expertise and extensive enterprise experience, Platinum Technology designs, implements, secures and manages Microsoft Cloud Infrastructure solutions. Platinum Technology is experienced at partnering with clients to turn their technology challenges into opportunities for innovation and success.

Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey with Platinum Technology? Apply now and become a valued member of our dynamic team!

title: Sulten på å drive din egen café? 🍓
description:
Vil du drive din egen café? Nå har du muligheten til å bli caféeier og forretningspartner hos Jordbærpikene Sartor🍓

Til høsten åpner Jordbærpikene på Sartor Storsenter – et av Vestlandets største og mest besøkte kjøpesentre. Nå ser vi etter deg som vil være med å bygge et nytt team og skape et sted der både gjester og kolleger trives. 🍓

Hva vil det si å være caféeier og forretningspartner i Jordbærpikene?

Som franchisetaker driver du din egen Jordbærpikene-café, med fullt ansvar for daglig drift, medarbeidere og økonomi. Samtidig får du tilgang til alt du trenger for å lykkes: grundig opplæring, etablerte systemer og løpende støtte fra vårt servicekontor.

Rollen krever at du er tett på driften – både for å bygge et sterkt team og for å sikre at gjestene får den lune og hyggelige opplevelsen Jordbærpikene er kjent for. Det handler om å kombinere kremmerånd med ekte lidenskap for service og kvalitet.

I ryggen har vi Bitastad – Norges ledende veksthus i serveringsbransjen. Som en del av Bitastad får vi tilgang til verdifull kompetanse, sterke fagmiljøer og et nettverk av lidenskapelige drivere. Dette gir både trygghet og utviklingsmuligheter – til glede for både gjester og medarbeidere.

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Er resultatorientert med god økonomiforståelse: Du har evne til å oppnå lønnsomhet og forstå sammenhengen mellom omsetning og kostnadskontroll.

  • Kan lede og motivere andre: Du skaper engasjement i teamet ditt, gir tydelig retning og prioriterer medarbeidernes trivsel og utvikling.

  • Setter kundene i sentrum: Du brenner for å skape gode opplevelser for gjestene og tilpasse driften til lokale behov, samtidig som du opprettholder merkevarens standarder.

  • Er konseptlojal og merkevarebevisst: Du forstår og respekterer rammene for Jordbærpikenes konsept, samtidig som du har blikk for hvordan små forbedringer kan gi stor effekt.

  • Er strukturert og tar eierskap: Du sørger for effektive rutiner og tar ansvar for å løse utfordringer på en profesjonell måte.

Hvorfor velge Jordbærpikene?

Når du blir franchisetaker hos Jordbærpikene, får du:

  • Full støtte og opplæring: Vi gir deg grundig opplæring i konsept og drift, inkludert kurs i økonomi, ledelse, markedsføring og HR.

  • Effektive systemer: Tilgang til butikkdatasystemer som sikrer enkel råvarekontroll og trygghet rundt matsikkerhet.

  • Personlig utvikling: Vi tilbyr løpende lederutvikling, inkludert årlige samlinger for inspirasjon og erfaringsutveksling.

  • En solid kjede i ryggen: Vi har tydelige vekstambisjoner og vil alltid heie på deg og støtte deg på din reise.

Du får et konsept som fungerer – men det er du som gir caféen din personlighet, bygger teamet og skaper entusiasme blant gjestene. Rollen gir en unik balanse mellom frihet og trygghet. 🍓

I tillegg er det viktig at du:

  • Får Eierskap til caféen

  • Har masse Lidenskap for folk og god service

  • Legger vekt på Samspill med ansatte og kunder

  • Har en god porsjon Kremmerånd i forklelomma

Vil du bruke Eierskap, Lidenskap, Samspill og Kremmerånd til å oppnå jordbær-suksess?

Send oss en søknad i dag, så tar vi en uformell prat for å bli bedre kjent. Sammen finner vi ut om dette er den rette muligheten for deg.

Kontaktinformasjon:

  • HR Business Partner, Siv Mykland - tlf. 995 85 052.

Søknadsfrist: 30. august

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg! 🍓

Sjekk gjerne ut vår karriereside og alle våre ledige stillinger ved å trykke her - da vil du få et enda større innblikk i hvordan det er å jobbe i Jordbærpikene 🍓

title: Expression of Interest: ICT & Cyber Security Opportunities
description:
About us

Willyama is a proudly Indigenous‑owned, Veteran‑led, and purpose‑driven Australian consultancy, delivering ICT, cyber security, and advisory services to defence, federal government as well as private‑sector clients.

We’re known for doing meaningful work, supporting our people, and creating real opportunities for First Nations professionals in technology. We value professionalism, capability, and collaboration, and we back our values with action.

Expanding Our Focus in South Australia

With growing demand in South Australia, we are actively expanding our SA talent footprint while continuing to build our broader Australia-wide team.

Where we work

We’re building a talent pool for future work across Australia, including:

  • Defence and federal government engagements
  • Secure and classified environments
  • Private‑sector and commercial consulting roles
  • Short‑term contracts and longer‑term engagements

Not all work requires clearance, and some opportunities sit outside Adelaide. If your skills are strong, we want to know about you.

If you’re not sure if you “tick all the boxes”, that’s okay. Reach out anyway. We’re building a broad talent pool for ICT roles.

Who we’re looking for

We welcome people at all stages of their career, from early-career and mid-level professionals through to senior specialists and leaders.

We are keen to connect with talent across a broad range of capabilities, particularly in:

  • Cyber Security & Advisory: GRC, IRAP assessments, security operations, threat intelligence, and security architecture
  • ICT Support & Infrastructure: Service Desk (Levels 1-3), systems administration, cloud engineering, and DevOps/DevSecOps
  • Architecture & Engineering: Solution, enterprise, cloud, and systems architecture
  • Data & Analytics: Data engineering, data architecture, and analytics
  • Program, Delivery & Quality: Project managers, delivery leads, business analysts, and QA / Test Engineers.

Experience & Clearances

While experience in government, defence, or regulated environments is a plus, strong core ICT skills and proven technical capability are what matter most. If you hold, have held, or are eligible for an Australian Government security clearance, we are especially keen to hear from you.

How to get in touch

Whether you call South Australia home or are based elsewhere in Australia and keen to work with us, please submit your updated CV via the link. We’ll review EOIs as part of our broader talent pool and reach out when a suitable opportunity aligns.

title: Operations Officer, Greater China
description:
Work Arrangement: Primarily office-based, with flexibility for remote work by mutual agreement with the manager and in line with business needs.

YOUR POSITION WITH TNC

The Operations Officer, Greater China will work as part of a team within a business unit coordinating tasks related to one or more functional activities, such as operations support, procurement, meetings management, special events, training, volunteer programs, etc.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

The Operations Officer, Greater China will work towards meeting the strategic priorities of the program by implementing tactics for approved plans and completing day-to-day tasks and activities. They may be responsible for planning and execution of logistics for special events and/or meetings, purchasing, filing, mailroom operations, facility management, telecommunications, and/or reception. They may assist with the recruitment, training, and recognition of program volunteers, and may direct the activities of volunteers. In addition, the Officer may work closely with Information Systems, Human Resources, and Finance administrative tasks, including processing forms, preparing reports and forecasts, and monitoring and preparing budgets. They will respond to inquiries about program activities, create program materials, and draft correspondence. They will be well versed in the systems and resources utilized by the team in order to execute assigned tasks. The Officer will provide guidance in satisfying administrative requirements based on extensive knowledge of policies and procedures. They will provide support and targeted training related to the functional area of the team. They will implement processes and practices in order to improve effectiveness. The Officer will communicate with staff in various programs across the Conservancy, as well as with donors, volunteers, vendors, and business relations. They will communicate or distribute information to assist staff in making decisions, solving problems, and improving workflow.

Greater China OPERATIONS

  • Facilities Staff meeting, organize various types of staff activities (gathering, retreat and training)

  • Support event happening in the region (logistics for guests visits or provide proof of employment letter or invitation letter for visa applications purpose)

  • Support onboarding setup and separate process

  • Timesheet reminder, checking and review

  • Handle group medical insurance, International SOS

  • Being a member of AP Safety Committee to ensure workspace safety and keep the safety plan up to date

  • Procurement for office supplies with vendor liaison

  • Office maintenance

  • Provide administrative support amongst senior executives

  • Support on trips and events arrangement

RESPONSIBILITIES & SCOPE

  • Work within scope of program’s strategic goals;

  • Act independently on assigned tasks and exercise independent judgment based on analysis and experience, referring difficult questions and unusual problems to supervisor;

  • Coordinate projects with several variables, working within a defined timeline and budget;

  • Demonstrate sensitivity in handling confidential information;

  • Perform non-routine analysis, research and follow-through;

  • Ensure compliance with Conservancy policies and procedures, and external (donor/legal/IRS) requirements;

  • Financial responsibility includes purchasing, processing invoices, contracting with vendors, and assisting with budget preparation;

  • May act as a resource to others to solve problems and act in supervisor’s stead when instructed;

  • May supervise administrative and/or volunteer staff, including training and professional development;

  • Provide input through project teams for the improvement of existing programs;

  • Travel and work flexible hours as needed;

  • Work environment involves only infrequent exposure to disagreeable elements and minor physical exertion and/or strain; and

  • Work is diversified and may not always fall under established practices and guidelines.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree and 2 years related experience or equivalent combination;

  • Experience coordinating administrative processes;

  • Experience generating reports and interpreting data;

  • Experience in business writing, editing, and proofreading;

  • Experience organizing time and managing diverse activities to meet deadlines; and

  • Experience working across teams and communicating with a wide range of people

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Multi-lingual skills and multi-cultural or cross-cultural experiences are appreciated;

  • Ability to analyze information for the purpose of coordinating and planning activities, and solving problems;

  • Ability to use existing technology to achieve desired results;

  • Excellent customer service skills and focus;

  • Experience interpreting guidelines to achieve desired results;

  • Knowledge of current trends in specific field; and/or

  • Strong organization skills, accuracy, and attention to detail.

Who We Are:


The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.

One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

What We Bring:


Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

TNC offers competitive and comprehensive benefits packages tailored to the individual countries where we work. These may include health care benefits, retirement benefits, parental leave, paid time off, life insurance, and disability coverage as well as an employee assistance program and other life and well-being benefits. Learn more about our Benefits and Perks here.

We’re proud to offer a flexible work environment that supports the health and well-being of the people we employ.

Our recruiting process includes a rolling interview process to ensure we engage applicants in a timely manner. This means we may review applications in the order in which they are received. Once a strong candidate pool is identified, the role will be unposted. The timeline may vary depending on the expressed interest in the role, so we highly encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

Employees must submit their application by logging into Workday and applying via the Jobs Hub.

The Nature Conservancy is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our commitment to equal employment opportunity includes the recognition that our conservation mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people of all backgrounds, beliefs, and culture. Recruiting and mentoring staff to create an inclusive organization is a priority, and we encourage applicants from all cultures, races, colors, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military, protected veteran status or other status protected by law.

The successful applicant must meet the requirements of The Nature Conservancy's background screening process.

TNC is committed to offering accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please send a note to applyhelp@tnc.org with Request for Accommodation in the subject line.

title: Integration Developer
location: Kingston Upon Thames, South West London
description:
Integration Developer
Kingston-on-Thames (4 days in office, 1 WFH day)
37.5 hours per week

Crew Clothing Company is a British lifestyle brand operating across four brands — Crew Clothing, Pringle of Scotland, Saltrock and Ben Sherman — with 130+ Crew stores, a growing digital channel and an omnichannel customer experience. We are in the middle of a significant technology transformation: a new eCommerce platform, a new third-party logistics partner, and an upgrade to our ERP platform, all running concurrently and targeting delivery before the end of 2027.

Our IT team is small and highly capable. We are building an internal integration function that will own how all our systems connect — and this role is at the foundation of that team.

Purpose of the role:

Crew Clothing is building an internal integration capability to own how our systems connect — our eCommerce platform, our new warehouse platform, and our new ERP platform. As Integration Developer, you will be the person who builds and maintains those connections.
You will work within a small, focused integration team, building on Azure Integration Services to create the data flows and APIs that keep our trading systems in sync. This is hands-on development work with real commercial impact — the integrations you build will determine whether orders flow correctly, stock is accurate, and deliveries go out on time.
This role replaces an external day-rate dependency. We are bringing this capability in-house because we want to own it — and that means you will have genuine long-term ownership of what you build.

What it involves:

  • Build and maintain integration flows between all Crew systems — our eCommerce platform, our warehouse management platform, our new ERP platform, and downstream applications
  • Own the Azure Integration Services layer — developing, testing, deploying and monitoring all integration pipeline.
  • Support our new warehouse go-live — monitoring integrations during hyper care, responding to incidents, and resolving failures quickly
  • Build our eCommerce OMS integration layer — working with our eCommerce delivery partner delivery team to ensure all Crew-owned integrations are built and tested correctly
  • Develop ERP integration components as our new ERP platform programme advances — building from a template design established by the Technical Lead
  • Write clear technical documentation for all integrations — runbooks, data flow diagrams, error handling guides
  • Participate in on-call rota for integration incidents during peak trading periods
Key Skills & Experience:


  • Solid experience in integration development — building APIs, event-driven flows, or middleware pipelines in a production environment
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Integration Services, Logic Apps, Service Bus or equivalent
  • Comfortable working with REST APIs, JSON, XML and common authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, API keys)
  • Experience integrating ERP, eCommerce or logistics platforms is a strong advantage
  • A debugging mindset — you enjoy finding out why something broke and fixing it properly
  • Reliable and thorough — you test your work, document what you build, and don't cut corners
  • Comfortable in a small team where you will need to work independently and take ownership of your delivery

If successful You will join a small integration team led by a Technical Lead (being appointed), alongside a QA and Delivery Planner. The team sits within the wider Crew Clothing IT function, reporting to the Director of Technology.
Three major programmes are running concurrently — our eCommerce platform, a new 3PL warehouse, and our new ERP platform — and your work will touch all three. This is a role with variety, genuine ownership, and the opportunity to build a system that will underpin how Crew trades for years to come.

title: Sterile Manufacturing Operator Lead (1st shift)
description:
Empower Pharmacy is a visionary healthcare company dedicated to making quality, affordable medication accessible to millions of patients nationwide. As the nation’s most advanced 503A compounding pharmacy and FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facility, we’re redefining what’s possible in personalized medicine and pharmaceutical manufacturing. We’re proud to be recognized as one of Houston’s fastest-growing private companies and ranked #116 in Healthcare & Medical on the Inc. 5000 List for 2025.

Our strength is built on four core values: People, Quality, Service, and Innovation. Guided by these principles, we’ve created a uniquely integrated healthcare platform powered by advanced technology, operational excellence, and a relentless commitment to patient care. From manufacturing and quality control to distribution and customer experience, our teams work together to raise industry standards, expand access to critical medications, and improve outcomes for patients and providers across the country.

At Empower, joining our team means more than starting a new role. It means becoming part of a mission-driven organization that’s transforming healthcare at scale. We invest deeply in our people, encourage bold thinking, and create opportunities for growth, leadership, and innovation at every level. Your ideas matter here, your development is supported, and the work you do has a direct impact on the lives of millions.

If you thrive in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment where innovation, collaboration, and ambition come together, Empower Pharmacy is the place for you. Let’s transform healthcare together.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Sterile Manufacturing Operator Lead drives execution across aseptic preparation, mixing, vial filling, documentation, and ISO-classified cGMP operations, protecting product quality, patient access, and production schedules. Owning workflow coordination, workforce deployment, training, escalation, and continuous improvement, this role converts standards into disciplined floor performance. AI serves as a force multiplier by accelerating production analysis, expanding visibility, improving decision quality, strengthening documentation review, and scaling learning without compromising compliance. In Empower's hyper-growth, highly regulated 503A/503B environment, the Lead partners across Manufacturing, Quality, and Technical Operations to sustain readiness, resolve constraints, and raise operating maturity. Success requires strategic thinking, execution rigor, learning agility, sound judgment, and resilience to deliver precise outcomes in a fast-moving sterile manufacturing setting while modeling Empower's values of people, quality, service, and innovation.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Sterile Operations Leadership

  • Shift Leadership: Lead daily sterile manufacturing activities across preparation, mixing, aseptic vial filling, cleaning, and disinfection, translating production schedules into clear priorities and coordinated execution. Monitor staffing, material readiness, equipment status, and workflow constraints throughout the shift. Use AI-enabled dashboards and exception alerts to improve visibility, accelerate decisions, and maintain safe, compliant output within Empower's fast-paced 503A/503B manufacturing environment while reinforcing ownership, accountability, performance, and consistent communication across assigned production activities.
  • Workforce Coordination: Allocate operators across critical work centers based on qualification, workload, production risk, and schedule demand while supporting breaks, coverage, and rapid response to changing priorities. Coach team members in real time and escalate staffing gaps early. Apply AI-assisted capacity insights to anticipate bottlenecks, balance labor efficiently, and improve throughput without weakening aseptic controls, documentation quality, or employee safety. Support effective handoffs across shifts and departments.
  • Floor Ownership: Maintain visible ownership of sterile manufacturing performance by confirming room readiness, line clearance, gowning discipline, material flow, and adherence to standard operating procedures. Identify deviations from expected conditions and initiate timely containment or escalation. Use digital and AI-supported checklists to strengthen consistency, accelerate verification, and identify recurring risk patterns while ensuring production commitments are met with uncompromising attention to quality, service, and patient impact.

Quality and Compliance Execution

  • Aseptic Compliance: Execute and reinforce cGMP, ISO-classified, and aseptic processing requirements during compounding and filling activities, including environmental controls, cleaning, disinfection, and contamination prevention practices. Observe behaviors, correct unsafe or noncompliant actions, and involve Quality when required. Leverage AI-guided knowledge tools to retrieve approved procedures efficiently, reinforce training, and improve decision consistency while ensuring human judgment and controlled documentation remain central to each decision and escalation pathway.
  • Record Review: Review batch records, logbooks, and manufacturing documentation for completeness, accuracy, traceability, and alignment with approved procedures before routing for formal Quality review. Resolve clear documentation issues promptly and escalate potential non-conformances. Use AI-assisted review capabilities to identify missing fields, inconsistent entries, and recurring error trends, increasing speed and quality while preserving data integrity, operator accountability, and compliance with Empower's regulated 503A/503B requirements.
  • Issue Response: Respond to equipment alarms, process interruptions, documentation discrepancies, and potential non-conformances by stabilizing operations, gathering facts, and escalating through established pathways. Support root-cause analysis and implementation of corrective actions within role authority. Apply AI-enabled trend analysis to connect recurring events, prioritize investigation signals, and improve response speed while partnering with Quality, Engineering, and leadership to protect product, people, and production continuity through timely, fact-based actions and documented follow-through.

Performance and Capability Improvement

  • Data Improvement: Analyze production, quality, downtime, and labor data to identify trends, recurring losses, and practical opportunities for continuous improvement. Translate findings into actions that strengthen cycle time, schedule adherence, right-first-time performance, and operational reliability. Use AI to accelerate pattern recognition, scenario evaluation, and visual reporting, then validate insights through floor observation and cross-functional review before implementing changes within Empower's high-growth, highly regulated manufacturing environment. Communicate recommendations with supporting evidence and measurable impact.
  • Team Development: Train and mentor new hires and developing operators on sterile processes, approved procedures, equipment use, documentation expectations, and disciplined problem-solving. Confirm understanding through observation, feedback, and qualification support. Use AI-enabled learning tools to personalize reinforcement, generate practice scenarios, and identify knowledge gaps at scale while maintaining approved content controls and building a culture of learning agility, collaboration, accountability, safe behaviors, and sustained technical excellence.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, Warehouse, and Technical Operations to coordinate priorities, resolve constraints, and improve sterile manufacturing readiness. Communicate status, risks, and support needs clearly across shifts and functions. Use AI-supported summaries and action tracking to accelerate alignment, improve follow-through, and strengthen decision quality while contributing floor expertise that enables scalable processes, successful launches, and consistent service to patients and providers.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Working knowledge of sterile compounding, aseptic vial filling, ISO-classified environments, cGMP practices, contamination control, cleaning, disinfection, and controlled manufacturing documentation.
  • Ability to lead daily execution, allocate labor, coach peers, manage changing priorities, and communicate risks clearly across Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, and support teams.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel or comparable spreadsheet tools, production metrics, basic math, digital work instructions, and responsible use of AI-enabled analysis and knowledge tools.
  • Strong attention to detail, resourcefulness, situational adaptability, accountability, and learning agility, with disciplined judgment in fast-paced, highly regulated manufacturing operations.

EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum of one (1) year of compounding experience required.
  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Demonstrated strong attention to detail, self-motivation, and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively in a controlled environment and follow detailed instructions.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or other spreadsheet software and basic math skills required; experience in a lead or mentoring role preferred.

Key Competencies:

  • Customer Focus: Builds trust through customer-centric solutions.
  • Strategic AI: Guides responsible AI adoption and adaptation.
  • Optimizes Work Processes: Drives efficiency with continuous improvement.
  • Collaborates: Partners effectively to achieve shared goals.
  • Resourcefulness: Secures and deploys resources efficiently.
  • Manages Complexity: Simplifies and solves complex challenges.
  • Ensures Accountability: Delivers on commitments with integrity.
  • Situational Adaptability: Adjusts approach to shifting conditions.
  • Communicates Effectively: Tailors messages to diverse audiences.

Values:

  • People: Empowering people defines who we are.
  • Quality: Excellence in every product, every time.
  • Service: Serving others is our highest purpose.
  • Innovation: Advancing care through technology and discovery.

Employee Benefits, Health and Wellness:

We offer comprehensive benefits to support your health, well-being, and future, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, 401(k) matching, wellness perks, IV therapy, and compounded medications. Learn more: https://careers.empowerpharmacy.com/benefits/

Employees are regularly required to move about the office and around the corporate campus. The employee is regularly required to stand, walk, reach with arms and hands, climb or balance, and to stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.

title: Junior Stock Analyst
description:
About Eagles

For over 55 years, Eagles Plumbing Plus has proudly served the Central Coast, Newcastle, Hunter Region, and Mid-North Coast of NSW. As the largest locally owned and operated independent plumbing supplies company in the region, we are growing—and we’re on the lookout for smart, motivated individuals to kickstart their career with us.

About the Role

Are you a tech-savvy problem solver who genuinely loves working with spreadsheets? Whether you’re a recent university graduate or just naturally brilliant with numbers, systems, and data, this is the perfect entry-level opportunity for you.

We are looking for a sharp, detail-oriented Junior Stock & Data Analyst to join our Purchasing & Warehousing team in West Gosford. You’ll work alongside experienced team members assisting with stock statistics, system pricing, supplier data, and inventory management.

If you have an eagle eye for detail and want to turn your strong IT and Excel skills into a rewarding career, we want to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

  • Data & Excel Operations: Update and maintain supplier pricing files, inventory codes, and product master data across our systems.

  • Inventory & Stock Tracking: Assist with monthly reporting, stock conversions, and creating distribution/packing lists.

  • Supplier Coordination: Prepare purchase orders, maintain supplier price tracking sheets, and help manage communication regarding price updates and quotes.

  • System Maintenance: Work with business software (ERP/BI tools) to keep sell prices, landed costs, and standard costing matrices accurate.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong Excel / Google Sheets Skills (Non-Negotiable): You don't need years of job experience, but you must be comfortable with functions like XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, and working with large datasets.

  • High Attention to Detail: You’re meticulous. You double-check your work and notice when a number or code looks off.

  • Tech & IT Savvy: You pick up new software quickly and enjoy learning new systems.

  • A "Can-Do" Attitude: You’re proactive, eager to learn, and excited to jump into a supportive team environment.

  • University degree (e.g., Business, IT, Commerce, Math) is welcome, but not required if you have the technical aptitude and drive!

What We Offer

  • Competitive Entry-Level Package: Commensurate with skills.

  • On-the-Job Training: Great opportunity to build a career in supply chain, inventory, and data analytics.

  • Great Local Culture: A supportive, fast-paced, and friendly local team right here on the Central Coast.

Ready to jumpstart your career?

Submit your resume along with a quick cover note telling us why you love data and working in Excel!
